Reporting to the Vulnerability Manager, the VM  Engineer will be responsible for identifying, analysing, and supporting the remediation of vulnerabilities across Cloudflare's Infrastructure and cloud environments.You will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, cloud and compliance teams to identify, triage, and drive timely and effective remediation of security vulnerabilities in line with defined SLAs. A key focus of the role will be supporting DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, ensuring vulnerability processes, evidence, and tooling align with regulatory and assurance requirements. You will also apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to enhance scanning efficiency, triage accuracy, and automated remediation pathways. We are looking for a proactive, detail oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple remediation activities in parallel.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct vulnerability scanning, and perform in-depth analysis of  findings from scanning tools (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7), to verify accuracy, identify systemic patterns, and filter out false positives.
  • Triage, validate and prioritise vulnerabilities using risk based approaches to determine real business impact, and working with engineering and compliance teams to agree remediation actions and timelines.
  • Develop, document, and deliver technical remediation guidance and solutions to enable application and infrastructure teams to remediate efficiently and consistently.
  • Support DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, by ensuring vulnerability management processes, evidence, reporting, and controls meet regulatory and assurance expectations.
  • Work closely with engineering and service teams to embed vulnerability management into delivery pipelines , operational processes and change management. 
  • Leverage AI security tools and automation to streamline triage, pattern recognition, and risk prioritisation.
  • Establish strong relationships with engineering teams to track and report status and remediation progress
  • Manage and track the remediation backlog, maintaining focus on risk reduction and measurable progress.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of vulnerability management standards, procedures, and playbooks, ensuring alignment with IL4, Fedramp and other compliance requirements.

Must-Have Skills

  • Solid understanding of DoD Impact level IL4, FedRAMP, SOC-2, and PCI frameworks.
  • 3+ years  Vulnerability Management experience in a heavily regulated environment.

title: Business Development Representative, East
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Washington, DC – Onsite 4 Days/Week (Mon–Thurs)

Relocation required if not local – no relocation assistance provided

 

The Team

At Okta, we’re building the world’s identity platform — one that empowers people, protects data, and fuels digital innovation. Our customers (think: JetBlue, T-Mobile, Sonos, Zoom) trust us to help them stay secure, seamless, and scalable in a world where everything and everyone is connected.

And behind the tech? People like you — curious, motivated, collaborative learners who want to do meaningful work alongside great teammates.

 

The Opportunity: Where High Potential Meets High Impact

We get it: There are a lot of BDR roles out there. But at Okta, we do things differently.

This isn’t just a cold-call grind or a pit stop on your way to something else — it’s the start of a high-growth, high-visibility career path in one of the most exciting spaces in tech: cybersecurity and identity.

We’re looking for self-starters who are hungry to learn, open to coaching, energized by challenge, and excited to be part of a team that wins together. As a BDR at Okta, you'll help tell our story, spark valuable conversations, and play a key role in building pipeline for one of the top sales orgs in tech.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Engage inbound leads and qualify interest in Okta’s products — you’ll be the first human touchpoint for many of our future customers
  • Generate high-quality meetings and pipeline by creating thoughtful, relevant outreach via phone, email, and social
  • Conduct discovery calls to uncover real business problems — and tee up Account Executives to solve them
  • Use tools like Salesforce and Outreach to manage your book of business and stay organized
  • Hit your KPIs and quota — and have fun doing it, with team competitions, shout-outs, and mentorship

 

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience
  • A strong communicator, written and verbal — you know how to connect
  • Comfortable juggling priorities and managing your time in a fast-paced environment
  • Self-motivated — you don’t wait to be told what to do, you figure it out (and ask questions when you’re stuck)
  • Coachable — you’re open to feedback and excited to get better, every day
  • Curious — you love to learn, explore, and ask “why?”
  • Collaborative — you believe that success is a team sport, and you're all in

 

A Few Logistics

  • This role is onsite in our Washington DC office 4 days per week (Mon–Thurs)
  • If you're not already local, you’ll need to relocate within an agreed-upon timeframe — note that Okta does not provide relocation assistance
  • You’ll attend in-person onboarding in either San Francisco or Chicago to kick off your journey
  • If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know here

The Opportunity

The Global Demand Center is building a signal-led demand engine — one that uses account, audience, behavioral, intent, and market signals to identify where we should focus and how we should activate. The GrowthX team, within the Global Demand Center, is taking the lead on this initiative and looking for a new Demand Signals Specialist. 

The Demand Signals Specialist will help turn signal-led strategy into accurate, actionable audiences that can be used across campaigns, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation channels.

This role is focused on audience build, enrichment, segmentation, QA, and activation readiness. They will work across teams to understand unique intent and fit signals to create impactful audiences for GrowthX programs. The ideal candidate is early in their career but technically curious, detail-oriented, comfortable working across modern GTM platforms, and excited to help build the audience foundation for a more dynamic demand model.

What You’ll Do

Build account and contact audiences

Build account, contact, and buying-group audiences based on direction from GrowthX strategy leads, campaign teams, field marketing, and journey teams.

Use tools such as Clay and Common Room to support audience creation, enrichment, segmentation, contact discovery, buying-group identification, and account research.

Apply required filters, exclusions, segmentation logic, region/segment views, product focus, persona criteria, suppression rules, and activation requirements.

Support both planned campaign audiences and signal-triggered growth motions.

Prepare audiences for activation

Package audience outputs for use by campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, digital activation, and xDR teams.

Communicate audience size, coverage, regional breakdowns, segment views, exclusions, data gaps, intent, and activation readiness.

Help ensure audiences are structured in a way that can be used downstream in systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, and other campaign or activation platforms.

Own audience QA and data quality checks

Review audience builds for accuracy, duplication, completeness, field quality, enrichment quality, persona/title fit, suppression logic, region/segment accuracy, and alignment to stated criteria.

Flag issues, gaps, or unexpected findings to GrowthX strategy leads and stakeholders.

Recommend adjustments when audience size, coverage, quality, or data availability may limit activation.

Document audience logic and QA findings so teams understand what was included, excluded, and why.

Partner cross-functionally

Work closely with GrowthX leaders, campaign managers, field marketing, journey architecture, marketing automation, and activation teams to support audience needs.

Clarify build requirements, timelines, audience logic, data sources, and handoff expectations.

Support a more consistent audience operating model across Okta or Auth0 platform priorities.

1–3+ years of experience in marketing operations, growth operations, campaign operations, audience operations, demand generation, sales operations, data operations, or a related field.

Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, lists, filters, segmentation logic, and QA processes.

Experience or strong familiarity with B2B marketing and sales systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Clay, Common Room, or comparable GTM platforms.

Comfort working with account and contact data, including enrichment, deduplication, segmentation, exclusions, and audience handoffs.

Ability to communicate audience size, coverage, data gaps, and QA findings clearly to stakeholders.

You understand bleeds, resolutions at architectural scale, color management (CMYK, Pantone matching), and vendor handoff specs.

  • Collaborative Conviction: Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate design rationale, incorporate stakeholder feedback thoughtfully, and maintain high standards of visual excellence.

  • Working knowledge of 3D spatial software or spatial visualization tools (SketchUp, Cinema 4D, Blender, or Vectorworks).
  • Experience localizing creative for international regional series (EMEA and APJ markets).
  • Direct experience communicating with fabrication shops and conducting on-site print/install inspections.

Okta Secures AI is Okta's product line for agent identity—securing what AI agents can access and do across the enterprise.

This role owns GTM readiness across the full customer lifecycle, from first conversation through deployment, adoption, and expansion. Pre-sales, you ensure AEs, SEs, and FDEs can position, demo, differentiate, and win. Post-sales, you ensure Professional Services, partners, TAMs, CSMs, and FDEs can deploy, drive adoption, and expand.

This is a strategy role, not a traditional enablement role. You own the customer insight, messaging, positioning, competitive intelligence, and readiness strategy. You build from what you hear in customer conversations and see in live deployments, then partner with the teams that own enablement and delivery to scale it.

AI is moving weekly. The work needs to move just as fast.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Sales Readiness

  • Messaging and positioning: Build the narrative, value proposition, proof points, and persona-specific stories sellers use in live deals.
  • Competitive readiness: Develop competitive positioning, objection handling, and talk tracks as the market evolves.
  • Demo readiness: Equip SEs and FDEs with the stories, scenarios, and technical depth needed to demonstrate Okta Secures AI credibly.
  • Launch and pricing readiness: Ensure the field understands what's new, what's changed, and how to take it to market.
  • Field signal: Partner directly with sellers and SEs to identify gaps in live deals and turn those insights into reusable solutions.

Post-Sales Readiness

  • Partner readiness: Help SI and implementation partners deliver Okta Secures AI deployments to the same standard as Okta Professional Services.

Strategic Scope & Influence

You will own the GTM strategy behind readiness—not the training channels themselves.

Your scope includes:

  • Messaging architecture: Define what each audience needs to know and say while maintaining one consistent Okta Secures AI narrative.

  • Competitive strategy: Help the organization win against competitors before the sale and defend the business after it.
  • Launch readiness: Set the readiness bar for new products, releases, and pricing changes across the customer lifecycle.
  • Customer evidence: Turn customer conversations, deployments, and outcomes into insights and proof the organization can use.

About the team

As the leading independent identity provider for the enterprise, Okta is on a mission to build a world-class brand. Driving that mission is the Brand & Creative team: a dynamic group of art directors, designers, writers, strategists, project managers, and producers who bring the Okta brand to life across every touchpoint.

Within Brand & Creative, our team tells powerful stories, elevates high-visibility moments, and crafts design systems that scale across digital and physical environments globally. We partner closely with cross-functional teams across Marketing to turn major strategic initiatives into inspiring, category-defining creative work.

About the role

As a Motion Designer, you will occupy a unique and influential intersection on our team: balancing the rigor of our central motion design system with the versatility to concept and craft bespoke, show-stopping motion for our most critical brand moments.

We are looking for a nimble, craft-obsessed motion designer who moves fluidly between two complementary mindsets:

  1. The Systems Architect: Building, maintaining, and codifying scalable motion infrastructure—modular After Effects templates, MOGRTs, centralized toolkits, and expression-driven assets that keep our visual identity unified and empower the broader creative team to move fast.
  2. The Bespoke Maker: Developing dynamic, impact-focused creative solutions that break through the noise—whether designing immersive LED screen loops for flagship events like Oktane, animating punchy social storytelling, elevating high-stakes brand campaigns, or breathing kinetic life into brand films.

If you love sweating the micro-details of timing, easing, and visual storytelling just as much as you love building smart, reusable systems that elevate an entire brand, this role is built for you.

What you'll be doing

  • Balance Systems & Bespoke Craft: Seamlessly oscillate between scaling our central motion design system and rolling up your sleeves to execute custom, high-visibility animation across campaigns, events, digital, and video.
  • Architect & Maintain Central Motion Systems: Champion Okta’s motion guidelines and infrastructure. Design, document, and maintain modular After Effects project templates, Essential Graphics (MOGRTs), and reusable motion libraries that make on-brand motion accessible to internal collaborators and external agency partners.
  • Deliver High-Impact Event Experiences: Concept and execute bespoke motion packages for owned flagship events (Oktane) and major industry activations (AWS re:Invent, RSAC, NRF, etc.). Craft immersive keynote walk-in loops, speaker intros, and environmental stage graphics tailored to custom LED dimensions and experiential spaces.
  • Craft Standout Brand & Campaign Motion: Partner with our Senior Motion Designer and Creative Leads to translate high-level campaign briefs into expressive motion graphics, kinetic typography, and animated concepts that elevate product launches, brand announcements, and company milestones.
  • Drive Dynamic Social & Digital Storytelling: Bring fresh energy, pacing, and visual wit to social channels (LinkedIn, YouTube, X) and digital touchpoints, translating complex enterprise security and AI narratives into captivating, scroll-stopping visual content.
  • Elevate Video & Branded Content: Collaborate with video editors and producers on title sequences, kinetic type treatments, UI animations, and motion graphic overlays for customer case studies, product sizzles, and brand films.
  • Push the Boundaries of Brand Motion: Experiment and explore new kinetic expressions for the Okta visual identity, testing how our visual language, iconography, and graphic elements behave dynamically across 2D and 3D spaces.
  • End-to-End Production & Optimization: Own motion assets from initial styleframes and storyboarding through final animation, audio sync, rendering, compression, and delivery across broadcast, web, social, and non-standard event display formats.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Experience: 3+ years of dedicated motion design experience in-house at a fast-paced tech company, creative branding agency, or motion studio, demonstrating equal strength in system building and bespoke creative execution.
  • Dual-Track Creative Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance disciplined, organized systems thinking (templates, toolkits, brand consistency) with the agility and creative fire needed to craft inventive, one-of-a-kind motion moments.
  • Tool & Craft Mastery (Required): Expert-level proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, and the core Adobe Creative Cloud suite (Illustrator, Photoshop). Sound, intuitive command of motion fundamentals: kinetic typography, spatial staging, easing curves, rhythm, and visual hierarchy.
  • Motion Systems & Templating Fluency: Hands-on experience developing modular After Effects templates, Essential Graphics/MOGRTs, and standardized project setups that enable team-wide scalability.
  • Versatile, Impact-Driven Portfolio: A standout reel and portfolio showcasing a balanced breadth of work—from large-scale event stage animations and campaign hero pieces to social content and structured motion toolkits.
  • Technical Fluency: Solid command of digital video formats, aspect ratios, framerates, codecs, and render optimization across mobile, desktop, and large-format physical screen arrays.
  • Collaborative & Agile Attitude: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with comfort advocating for motion rationale, adapting to feedback, and thriving in an iterative, fast-moving creative environment.

Extra points if you have

  • 3D Motion Capability: Working knowledge of 3D motion design and rendering tools (Cinema 4D, Blender, Redshift, Octane).
  • Expression Scripting: Familiarity with writing After Effects expressions to build smarter, automated, dynamic MOGRTs and templates.
  • Experiential & Stage Tech: Practical experience creating motion graphics for custom LED resolutions, spatial light mapping, or experiential digital signage.
  • Multi-Brand & Localization: Experience managing motion assets across multi-brand ecosystems or localizing toolkits for global marketing teams.

Why you should be excited about this role

  • You get the best of both worlds: the technical satisfaction of building foundational, high-leverage motion systems and the creative freedom to direct bespoke, boundary-pushing work.
  • Your creative output will be seen by hundreds of thousands of people across global keynote screens, high-profile campaigns, and multi-channel digital touchpoints.
  • You will directly influence how one of the most vital enterprise identity and security brands moves, transitions, and expresses itself in modern visual culture.
  • You will work alongside a collaborative, craft-first team of art directors, designers, and storytellers who celebrate bold creative swings and visual excellence.

Why we are excited about you

  • You don’t believe in choosing between systemic efficiency and creative distinction—you know how to make systems flexible enough to inspire great art.

title: People Consultant
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

At Okta, the Manager Success & Experience team helps managers lead effective teams through an AI-first support model that combines digital coaching and self-service resources with experienced human advisory. AI-powered guidance serves as the first point of support for everyday leadership and people-management questions, while People Consultants provide individualized coaching and problem-solving for situations that require deeper context, judgment, or expertise beyond standard resources. The team partners with AI resource teams, Enablement, and regional specialists to strengthen manager capabilities and continuously improve the support experience.

Role 

The People Consultant independently manages advisory cases that require deeper diagnosis, tailored coaching, or problem-solving beyond AI guidance and standard playbooks. Supporting managers across the full manager lifecycle, this role addresses leadership effectiveness, employee development, team dynamics, organizational change, performance management, and early-stage employee relations. You will own cases from assessment through resolution or specialist handoff, applying sound judgment within established decision-making frameworks to address root causes, build manager capability, and inform improvements to AI guidance and support resources.manager resources.

This is a hybrid roles that requires working in our San Francisco or Chicago office 2 days a week. 

Responsibilities

  • Coach managers on leadership effectiveness, employee development, feedback, engagement, team dynamics, and organizational change.
  • Independently assess and resolve advisory cases that require individualized support beyond AI guidance and standard playbooks.
  • Diagnose root causes of performance challenges, communication breakdowns, interpersonal conflict, and organizational barriers to recommend sustainable solutions.
  • Guide managers through performance improvement plans, sensitive conversations, documentation, and related employment decisions within delegated authority.
  • Apply established risk and escalation frameworks to determine when matters require Employee Relations & Compliance (ER&C), Employment Legal, Strategic PBPs, Labor Relations, or regional specialists.
  • Maintain clear case documentation, track agreed actions, and assess the effectiveness of interventions to support lasting outcomes.
  • Identify recurring case themes, gaps in AI guidance, and opportunities to improve coaching content, knowledge resources, workflows, and escalation criteria in partnership with AI resource teams and Enablement.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 3+ years with a Master’s degree, in Human Resources, HR Business Partnering, Employee Relations, management coaching, organizational development, or a related advisory discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex advisory cases, diagnose root causes, and exercise sound judgment within established decision-making boundaries.
  • Strong coaching, communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to guide managers through sensitive conversations and challenging decisions.
  • Working knowledge of leadership effectiveness, team development, performance management, employee engagement, early-stage employee relations, and appropriate specialist handoffs.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools and digital platforms to assess guidance, identify limitations, and determine when individualized human support is needed.
  • Ability to assess risk, recognize patterns across cases, recommend practical improvements, and help managers build the skills and confidence to resolve future challenges independently.

At Okta, we’re building the world’s identity platform — one that empowers people, protects data, and fuels digital innovation. Our customers (think: JetBlue, T-Mobile, Sonos, Zoom) trust us to help them stay secure, seamless, and scalable in a world where everything and everyone is connected.

And behind the tech? People like you — curious, motivated, collaborative learners who want to do meaningful work alongside great teammates.

Let’s be real: There are a lot of SDR roles out there. But at Okta, we do things differently.

This isn’t just a stepping stone — it’s your launchpad into a long-term sales career in one of the most exciting industries in tech: cybersecurity and identity.

We’re looking for driven, curious individuals who thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace feedback, and want to make a tangible impact every day. As an SDR at Okta, you'll do more than prospect — you’ll uncover real business challenges, collaborate cross-functionally, and set the foundation for meaningful customer relationships.

  • Research accounts and contacts to develop thoughtful outreach strategies using tools like Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Account Executives to plan and execute prospecting campaigns

  • Hit your call, email, meeting, and pipeline goals — and have fun doing it, with team competitions, shout-outs, and ongoing support
  • Keep your data organized and up-to-date in Salesforce
  • Work with cross-functional partners to continuously improve how we connect with our customers

 

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 6–12 months of prior business experience preferred
  • A strong communicator, written and verbal — you know how to connect
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented — you take initiative and follow through
  • Comfortable managing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Coachable — you’re open to feedback and eager to grow
  • Curious — you ask great questions and are always looking to learn
  • Familiarity with sales tools like Salesforce, Outreach, and Sales Navigator is a plus

 

A Few Logistics

  • This role is onsite in our Washington DC office 4 days per week (Mon–Thurs)
  • If you're not already local, you’ll need to relocate within an agreed-upon timeframe — note that Okta does not provide relocation assistance
  • You’ll attend in-person onboarding in either San Francisco or Chicago to kick off your journey
  • If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know here

 

Why Okta?

You could sell anything — so why not sell something that truly matters?

At Okta, we help people and businesses access the technology they need safely and easily. And behind our mission is a culture of trust, growth, and belonging. We invest in our people with real support, meaningful work, and the freedom to take ownership of your career from day one.

description:

Description

We are seeking a ServiceNow ITAM Developer to join our ServiceNow Platform Team. This role is a key driver in our mission to manage the full lifecycle, compliance, and financial impact of our global technology footprint. You will serve as the technical SME for Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM), ensuring our platform delivers an accurate, real-time view of asset visibility and cloud consumption.

This is a highly collaborative and integrated role. You will work closely with our SAM Managers to translate complex asset management business processes into technical solutions that identify and capture cost-saving opportunities. You will manage a sophisticated ecosystem that connects financial data from Workday and NetSuite, procurement data from Coupa, and endpoint data from JAMF and Intune. Your expertise will bridge the gap between technical data modeling and strategic business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical delivery for ServiceNow SAM and HAM, focusing on the Content Library, Normalization engines, and Reconciliation processes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to analyze asset management business processes and implement automated workflows that drive license reclamation and cost-avoidance strategies.
  • Oversee and troubleshoot complex integrations with core systems, including Coupa, Okta, JAMF, and Intune, ensuring data flow is consistent and accurate.
  • Build, configure, and maintain integrations with SaaS connectors (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, Adobe) and develop custom integrations for unique software vendors using IntegrationHub.
  • Build and maintain automated workflows for the hardware lifecycle, following Common Service Data Model (CSDM) best practices to keep the Asset and CI tables in sync.
  • Implement HAM Pro features like Hardware Model Normalization, Mobile Asset Tracking, and Asset Inventory Audit workflows.
  • Manage Cloud Cost Management (CCM) workflows to provide visibility and optimization for AWS and GCP spend.
  • Manage Software Spend Detection by integrating financial data from Workday and NetSuite to identify tail spend and shadow IT.
  • Design advanced dashboards and Performance Analytics widgets to report on compliance, cloud savings, and hardware refresh cycles for executive leadership.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience as a ServiceNow Developer, with at least 2 years of deep focus on SAM and HAM.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) is required; CIS–SAM or CIS–HAM is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ITAM business processes (e.g., procurement, deployment, harvesting, and disposal) and how they translate into platform configuration.
  • Expertise in the ServiceNow SAM data model and its relationship with the CMDB and CSDM, maintaining architectural integrity across Software Models, Entitlements, and Discovery Models
  • Proven experience with Cloud Cost Management/Optimization for AWS and GCP.
  • Hands-on experience building both Out-of-the-Box SaaS connectors and custom integrations using REST/JSON and IntegrationHub.
  • Technical proficiency in ServiceNow scripting, including JavaScript, GlideRecord, Flow Designer, and Scheduled Jobs.
  • Familiarity with discovery tools like ServiceNow Discovery, JAMF, and Intune, and their role in the normalization process.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex normalization and reconciliation issues by analyzing raw discovery data vs. library content.

The Okta Vision

Okta’s vision is to enable anyone to safely use any technology by providing a secure, highly available, enterprise-grade identity platform. Our technology secures billions of workforce logins each year.

At Okta, we empower our Account Executives from day one with a world-class onboarding experience, ongoing development, and a culture of support and collaboration.

The Opportunity: Strategic Account Executive

We are looking for a high-performing, self-motivated Account Executive with a passion for cybersecurity and helping organisations protect against evolving identity threats.

As AI adoption accelerates, identity is becoming even more critical. Organisations now need to secure not only employees and customers, but also non-human identities such as service accounts, automation tools, API keys, and AI agents. Okta helps customers bring these identities into a unified Identity Security Fabric, enabling greater visibility, governance, and secure access across the full identity lifecycle.

At Okta, you’ll join a company helping define the future of identity security in an AI-driven world, supported by strong onboarding, ongoing development, and a culture of collaboration from day one.

As an Strategic Account Executive at Okta, you will work closely with C-suite decision-makers to demonstrate how our platform drives secure, seamless access across their workforce. Your focus will be on both new business acquisition and expansion within our existing customer base.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Define and execute a clear territory plan with long-term strategic goals and growth targets.
  • Lead a cross-functional virtual team, including Partners, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Renewals, Services, and Business Development.
  • Drive consistent pipeline generation and revenue growth, meeting or exceeding quarterly targets.
  • Build strong, strategic relationships with customers in ANZ, earning trusted advisor status.
  • Champion Okta’s value through executive-level presentations, tailored demonstrations, and strategic engagements.
  • Establish yourself as a thought leader in identity, security, and cloud transformation.
  • Represent and embody Okta’s core values: Love Our Customers, Always Secure, Always On, Build and Own It, and Drive What’s Next.
  • Travel as needed to engage customers and key stakeholders.

What you’ll bring:

  • 10+ years of field sales experience, consistently exceeding targets in complex sales environments.
  • A proven track record of selling enterprise SaaS solutions to large Enterprise organisations. 
  • Experience working with GSIs and partner channels to drive aligned customer success.
  • Strong new business development skills, with deep account planning and execution capabilities.
  • A curious, adaptable mindset with a passion for learning and innovation.
  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, capable of influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with solution selling and frameworks like MEDDPICC and Command of the Message is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

Okta’s Germany Strategic Account Executive Sales Team is hiring!

Our Strategic Account Executives (SAE) are the visionary leaders who orchestrate and drive sales engagements for our most critical and prestigious Germany based customers.

In an era where Artificial Intelligence is transforming how enterprises operate, identity has become the new security perimeter. As an SAE, you won't just be selling software—you will act as a trusted, long-term advisor helping the C-suite safely navigate the AI revolution. You will build first-class Account Plans that map directly to your customers' overarching business strategies, digital transformation initiatives, and AI adoption plans. By championing value-based selling, you will translate complex technical capabilities into undeniable business outcomes, showing how secure identity is the ultimate enabler of modern enterprise innovation and ROI.

You will collaboratively plan and orchestrate the execution of aligned account strategies, ensuring robust opportunity generation, deep relationship alignment, and flawless account governance. Expect to lead from the front: presenting Okta’s transformational proposals, negotiating high-stakes terms, and bringing down complex, multi-layered, seven-figure deals that deliver massive win-win scenarios for both the customer and Okta.

Beyond managing existing relationships, you will hunt for new business leads that fit our ideal client profile, uncovering uncharted territory in the market. You will align closely with our Global partners to build sustainable strategic engagements, and leverage cutting-edge Account-Based Marketing to ensure Okta's investment continuously aligns with customer growth.

We are seeking a passionate, strategic, and hyper-focused professional to drive massive new revenue growth across Fortune 500 accounts. As an individual contributor, you will play a vital, high-visibility role in driving a significant share of revenue for Okta, helping the world's most prominent enterprises transition securely into a smarter, AI-driven future.

We provide our reps with an environment where they can make incredibly valuable contributions from day one, while also building endless opportunities for learning and career growth. The work you do here will directly impact the security, trust, and digital experience of the world's largest organizations.

As an Okta Strategic Account Executive, you will:

  • Establish a Vision: Create and execute a master plan to guide your long-term, strategic approach to the premier accounts assigned in your Territory.

  • Master Value Selling: Deeply understand your clients' business goals and tie Okta's solutions directly to their strategic imperatives, continuously selling on business value and ROI rather than just features.

  • Orchestrate Complex Deals: Navigate and close highly complex, multi-stakeholder, seven-figure deals, bringing together cross-functional teams to deliver transformational outcomes.

  • Enable Secure AI Transformation: Partner with clients to position identity as the critical foundation for their AI initiatives, ensuring they can safely deploy AI agents, automate workflows, and manage machine-to-machine identities without compromising security.

  • Expand & Deepen: Land, adopt, expand, and entrench sales opportunities within Fortune 500 accounts across your region.

  • Navigate the Org Chart: Explore the full spectrum of relationships and business possibilities across the client’s entire organizational structure, from technical buyers to the CIO, CISO, and Board of Directors.

  • Be a Thought Leader: Become the definitive authority on Okta’s platform, the vertical in which you are aligned, and the evolving security requirements of the modern, AI-first enterprise.

  • Leverage the Ecosystem: Holistically embrace, access, and utilize our channel and alliance partners to identify and crack open new, uncharted opportunities.

  • Collaborate to Win: Work as a unified team for the most efficient deployment of resources, providing timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions.

  • Champion the Platform: Represent Okta to prospective clients at executive sales presentations, site visits, and high-impact product demonstrations.

  • Build Partnerships: Cultivate highly effective working partnerships with your Okta colleagues globally (channel partners, sales engineering, business value management, customer first, etc.) with both humility and relentless enthusiasm.

You could be a great fit for this role if you have:

  • Proven Experience: A highly consistent track record in strategic field sales, specifically developing new logos and selling enterprise cloud software to Fortune 500 companies.

  • Complex Deal Expertise: A proven track record of successfully navigating, negotiating, and closing highly complex, six-to-seven-figure software cloud deals with prospects and customers in the defined territory.

  • Value-Selling Mastery: Deep experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques that focus on business value. (Knowledge of MEDDIC, Challenger methodologies, or similar frameworks is a massive plus!)

  • Forward-Looking Tech IQ: A solid understanding of how modern technologies, automation, and AI are reshaping enterprise security, data access, and cloud architectures.

  • Ecosystem Leverage: Previous success utilizing partners, channels, and alliances to sell more effectively and obliterate your quota.

  • Domain Knowledge: Experience selling complex cloud solutions in areas like enterprise Cloud/SaaS software, identity/security, infrastructure management, application development, or modern data platforms.

  • Market Creation Skills: A measurable track record in new business development and over-achieving sales targets, especially in high-growth, fast-changing environments or during market creation phases.

  • Executive Presence: Deep experience engaging with the “C” suite, possessing strong executive presence, immense polish, and world-class listening skills. German language skills are mandatory.

Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における8年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Austria, reporting to the Sales Director in the Enterprise sales department. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. In this role, you will take ownership of an assigned territory to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Take ownership of an assigned territory in Austria focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities with Enterprise prospects and customers
  • Demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of your customer and prospect organizations
  • Generate pipeline using new techniques, tools, joint field marketing initiatives, and top-tier channel partners including VAR, SI, and SP

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 3+ years of sales experience with a revenue quota, selling to Enterprise accounts in Austria
  • History of net new logo accomplishments with a clear understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships and internal resources for successful "team sales"
  • Willingness to be coached and the discipline to work a proven sales process from beginning to end
  • Fluency in German

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence, predictive forecasting, or conversational AI platforms to optimize enterprise territory planning and pipeline acceleration
  • Proficiency in strategic sales planning with experience closing net new logos
  • A consistent track record of winning business in Enterprise accounts

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・具体的なAI関連スキルの保有、または実務での活用経験

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、製造業等のお客様を担当するMajorチーム（従業員40000名以上のお客様担当）のリージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはSaaS業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.

We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Senior Account Executive (AE) - AI Security Strategic Accounts to join our Japan based team based in Tokyo to help accelerate growth in the highly competitive world of AI cybersecurity. This is both a customer acquisition and customer management role that combines communication skills, a consultative approach, and business / sales expertise to demonstrate the value of our platform from discovery calls closing projects.

As a Sr. AE, you will speak with dozens of new people every week including CISOs, AI development engineers, and security leaders. You will strive to form lasting customer relationships with the goal of building champions of Zscaler for years to come. You’ll also channel customer insights back into Zscaler’s product roadmap and marketing, helping us continuously push the frontier of AI security.

  • Strategic prospecting and driving GTM motion: Research and prospect into organizations using email, calls, networking, and other creative methods to guide early-stage pipeline development.

  • Activity Goals: You will exceed daily and weekly activity goals, delivering a high quantity of well-qualified sales opportunities.
  • Articulating our value proposition in AI Security: To assess buying interest, you will articulate our value proposition to decision makers across multiple industries.
  • Technical Understanding: You will attain a deep understanding and demonstrate Zscaler tech solutions to prospective clients about AI Security. 
  • Work closely with Sales Engineers in the sales process with potential prospects and customers.
  • Research and Education: You will research customers, identify decision-makers, educate prospects, and qualify buying interest.
  • Develop business value propositions based on customer situations and Zscaler offerings.
  • Communicate customer needs and objections to product and marketing teams.
  • Represent Zscaler at conferences and trade shows including booth work and networking sessions.
  • Maintain awareness of competitors and their products that compete against Zscaler products.

Who You Are (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Experienced in customer-facing GTM roles, ideally within cybersecurity or GenAI environments.
  • Knowledgeable in Generative AI, cybersecurity, or adjacent technical domains.
  • Skilled communicator, equally comfortable in c level meetings and executive briefings.
  • Strong problem-solver with a track record of resolving AI and business-related problems.
  • Experience with the MEDDIC sales methodology.
  • 5+ years of full sales cycle experience within software or security industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education. 

Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications)

・Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence, predictive forecasting, or conversational AI platforms to optimize enterprise territory planning and pipeline acceleration

  • Be part of the defining security challenge of our era: enabling safe AI adoption at enterprise scale.
  • Help shape the AI security category at a pivotal moment of growth.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

An agent doesn't go from a developer's laptop to production in one step here — it moves through a staged pipeline with real gates at every stage, then spends its first two weeks in production under close review before anyone trusts it to act on its own. As a Senior Agent Release Engineer, you'll own that entire path: the CI/CD pipeline every agent and every model change moves through, the automated checks that decide whether a release is safe to promote, and the rollback plan for when something isn't. You'll also own model tiering — making sure each agent is running on the model tier that actually fits its task, since that's one of the biggest cost levers on a platform running well over a hundred agents at once. If you like turning "we hope this works" into "here's the automated gate that proves it," this is that role.
 

Skills and competencies:

  • Own and continuously improve the CI/CD pipeline every agent and every model or prompt change moves through, from initial commit through sandbox, development, and staging, before anything reaches production.
  • Design and maintain the automated gates that decide whether a release is safe to promote — evaluation score thresholds, security scan results, guardrail test results — so a human isn't manually eyeballing test output before every promotion.
  • Own progressive rollout for model and agent changes: canary a change to a small slice of traffic or sessions first, watch the quality and cost metrics live, and only promote to full traffic once those metrics hold.
  • Build and maintain the rollback path for every stage of the pipeline, so that a bad release can be reversed in minutes, not hours, and so the trigger conditions for rollback are automatic rather than someone noticing a problem by chance.
  • Own model tiering across the agent fleet: routing agents to the model tier that actually fits their task complexity, and adjusting that routing as usage patterns or model pricing change.
  • Manage the shadow-period process for newly promoted agents, making sure the right metrics and review checkpoints are actually in place and visible before an agent moves from shadow to fully autonomous operation.
  • Run model version regression testing whenever a new model version becomes available, confirming existing agents don't silently degrade before that version gets adopted anywhere in production.
  • Partner with the Agent Runtime Engineer on the runtime side of releases to quickly troubleshoot issues in case of a bad rollout. 
Must-Have:
  • At least 5 years in CI/CD, release engineering, or MLOps, including 1–2 years releasing LLM or agent-based systems specifically.
  • Has designed and run a progressive rollout strategy (canary, shadow, or blue-green) for something stateful or model-driven, with automatic rollback triggers built in from the start, not a person noticing a problem and rolling back by hand.
  • Has gated a release on evaluation scores before, treating a regression as a hard stop the same way a failed test would, and can design that same kind of check to catch a new model version quietly degrading an existing agent before it touches production.
  • Strong Python (or similar) and solid infrastructure-as-code skills. Terraform, CDK, GitHub Actions, or CodePipeline all count.
  • Comfortable building and deploying containerized services with Docker, and owning their release path through CI/CD end to end.
 
Strong Advantage:
  • Direct experience with AWS Bedrock, or something comparable, including its deployment and versioning quirks.
  • Has made model tiering or cost-routing decisions — matched task complexity to model cost instead of defaulting everyone to the priciest option.
  • Worked somewhere release pipelines needed to produce evidence for an audit, not just pass internally.
  • Can explain the difference between traditional CI/CD (pass or fail) and AI release gating (thresholds and probability) to someone who's only worked in the former. That gap trips people up more than it should.

Every agent on this platform runs inside its own isolated environment, and someone has to make sure that environment actually behaves the way it's supposed to under real load, not just in a clean test run. As a Senior Agent Runtime Engineer, you'll own the health of the systems agents run on: keeping sessions isolated from each other, catching the failure modes that only show up under real concurrency, and making sure a slow or expensive agent gets caught before it becomes everyone's problem. You'll work closely with the engineers building the agents themselves, since you're often the first call when something behaves strangely in a real environment but not in a test one. If you like being the person who understands a system well enough to know exactly why it's misbehaving, this is that job.
 

Skills and competencies:

  • Own the health of the agent execution environment day to day — session isolation, resource limits, and catching the failure modes that only appear once real concurrency and real traffic patterns show up, not just in a clean test run.
  • Investigate and resolve cases where an agent behaves differently in production than it did in testing, working directly with the Agent Engineer or Quality Engineer who built it to figure out whether the problem is the agent's design or the environment it's running in.
  • Tune cold-start and concurrency settings for the platform's critical-path functions, and review them on a regular cadence as usage patterns shift rather than setting them once and forgetting them.
  • Understand the platform's session isolation model well enough to reason about its limits — where isolation is guaranteed by the underlying compute layer, and where the platform has to add its own controls because that guarantee doesn't fully hold.
  • Build and maintain the observability that lets someone answer "is this agent actually working correctly," not just "is it technically up" — tracing, behavioral drift detection, and quality signals sitting alongside the usual metrics and logs.
  • Track per-agent and per-session cost and efficiency, and flag agents that are burning more tokens, calling more tools, or running longer than the task should reasonably require.
  • Deploy and manage runtime-layer infrastructure resources through existing CI/CD pipelines as needed — provisioned concurrency settings, runtime-specific IAM roles, observability configurations, etc.
  • Run and improve the tests that validate isolation actually holds — for example, confirming that one agent's session genuinely can't reach or affect another's, not just assuming it because the platform is supposed to guarantee it.

 

Must-Have:
  • At least 5 years in a platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, with real production experience running serverless or containerized workloads on AWS (Lambda, Fargate, Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent) at meaningful scale.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS observability tooling (CloudWatch, X-Ray, or a comparable distributed tracing stack) — able to go from "something's wrong" to a root cause using traces and logs, not just dashboards.
  • Real experience deploying and managing infrastructure through CI/CD independently — comfortable owning IaC changes (Terraform, CDK, or similar) end to end rather than handing them off to someone else.
  • Working understanding of compute isolation concepts (containers, microVMs, or similar sandboxing models) and where their guarantees actually stop, since a lot of this role is reasoning about the edges of what a platform promises versus what it might not fully cover on its own.
  • Comfort investigating cost and performance problems at a granular level — able to trace an unexpectedly expensive or slow workload back to a specific cause, not just flag that costs went up.
  • Strong incident response instincts: staying calm and methodical while root-causing a live production issue, and following through with an actual fix rather than a workaround.
 
Strong Advantage:
  • Direct experience with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or any managed AI/agent runtime platform.
  • Experience with cold-start or concurrency tuning specifically (Lambda provisioned concurrency, container warm pools, or similar).
  • Exposure to a security-conscious or regulated environment where infrastructure changes go through a formal review or approval process.
  • Familiarity with LLM-specific cost drivers (token pricing, tool-call volume, model tiering) even if it wasn't the primary focus of a past role.

Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.

Netskope SASE Quality Engineers ensure the delivery of high-performance, scalable WAN edge and Cloud networking solutions. Driven by an automation-first and customer-centric approach, you will design and execute comprehensive tests—from feature-specific validation to complex, system-level scale—to guarantee flawless software delivery.

What’s in it for you

In this role, you will be a key member of the SASE team, championing quality and automation for our advanced WAN edge and Cloud networking products in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

What you will be doing

  • Understand the product/feature requirement, review the design and write test plans that suits the customer use cases
  • Responsible to own a feature end to end -  starting from testing, automation, script error free run in regression and customer issues handling around that
  • Thorough understanding of the product features and building the ability to debug the customer issues and suggest/implement the workarounds if applicable
  • Need to perform different types of testing that includes functional, system, performance and scale tests
  • Need to create the distributed complex test setups in various cloud platforms and hypervisors based on the requirement
  • Work closely with cross functional teams at various stages of product development to meet the feature deliverables in a release

Required skills and experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in software testing, quality engineering, or automation.
  • Strong expertise in one or more of the Windows, macOS, Linux and Android platforms, with experience testing system-level agents(VPN clients, or SASE/SSE clients ) in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge to bring up test environments, testing, automation  and troubleshooting in Windows/macOS and Linux platform
  • Strong expertise in L2/L3 networking concepts, routing protocols, VPN, IPSec and WAN architecture
  • Strong expertise in python programming language and should be able to do automation driven testing
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes environments
  • Familiarity with one of the major server virtualisation products (ESXi, KVM) & IaaS platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Good working knowledge in CI/CD deployment in public clouds
  • Technical know-how of source code systems like Github
  • Experience with traffic generator tools like Spirent and Ixia
  • Experience in scale and performance validation of endpoint client deployments
  • Experience with web programming and HTTP based APIs (REST or GraphQL)

Education

  • BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

About the position:

The Netskope Solutions Engineer - Service Providers is a strategic pre-sales role at Netskope. The SP Solution Engineer has a wide array of responsibilities focused on expanding our strategic Global Service Provider partner ecosystem.

As an SP Solutions Engineer, you will work closely with your account executive to embed Netskope technology into your partner’s advisory, implementation, and managed services offerings. You will leverage your technical expertise on the Netskope portfolio to ensure your partner can successfully obtain, onboard, and support new customers. 

This role requires a business-level understanding of how Global Service Providers do business, the vendors they work with and the key metrics they measure themselves by.

Responsibilities

Build meaningful relationships with our Partners:

  • This includes leveraging in-person, video conferencing, and any other medium applicable to stay closely connected to our Partners.
  • Build relationships spanning all the way from Engineers to Executives.

Educate and Evangelize:

  • You will proactively educate our Partners on the Secure Service Edge and SASE transformation and how Netskope is uniquely positioned to help them be successful. 
  • You will train Partners on Netskope leveraging both the Netskope Academy, online curriculum, self-developed content, and your own knowledge.
  • You will actively engage with a Partner’s sales team to drive Netskope's business and promote Netskope as the leader in Cloud Security.
  • You will closely track, manage and promote Netskope Certifications and Accreditations across the Partners you focus on. 
  • You will also assist in building the Netskope Prime program, recruiting new members, and contributing content to that program.
  • Pitch-Demo-POV: You will be instrumental in making sure our Partners are able to effectively (and independently) Pitch, Demo, and run a POV on Netskope. This starts with making sure we have developed all the resources they need. You will be instrumental in helping to build that content.

Netskope Practice Development:

  • In this role, you will also leverage your technical expertise on the Netskope platform and portfolio to develop practices within our Partner Community. These practices should directly lead to and ensure our partners can land, onboard, and support new customers.

About the position:

Netskope is seeking an accomplished, strategic, and transformational leader to serve as Vice President, Solutions Engineering for EMEA. Reporting directly to the WW Head of Solutions Engineering, this executive will lead and scale a high-performing Solutions Engineering organization across a diverse, multi-country region.

The VP, Solutions Engineering will be accountable for building an organization that consistently translates customer requirements and business objectives into compelling technical outcomes, technical wins and revenue. This leader will work closely with regional and WW Sales leadership, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to shape go-to-market strategy, improve technical win rates, accelerate sales cycles, and strengthen Netskope’s competitive position.

This is a leadership role centered on scaling people, leaders, methodology, technology, and execution. Individual technical delivery is secondary to building an organization capable of delivering consistent, high-quality technical outcomes at scale. The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of organizational leadership, commercial acumen, technical credibility, and executive presence.

The ideal candidate is a builder and change leader who has successfully transformed and scaled Solutions Engineering organizations in high-growth technology environments. They understand how to develop world-class talent, establish operating discipline, create scalable pre-sales methodologies, leverage data and AI to improve productivity, and build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Organization Leadership, Scaling and Talent

  • Lead, develop and scale a high-performing Solutions Engineering organization across multiple countries, cultures, and markets.
  • Build and develop a strong leadership bench through the recruitment, coaching, development and retention of SE leaders and individual contributors.
  • Establish clear career paths, succession plans, performance standards, and talent strategies that support sustained organizational growth.
  • Build multi-year headcount, capacity, and productivity plans aligned to revenue objectives and business growth.
  • Establish an operating model that appropriately balances field coverage, strategic account support, technical specialization, partner engagement, and organizational efficiency.
  • Create a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, technical excellence, collaboration and customer focus.
  • Develop the next generation of SE leaders and ensure the organization can scale without becoming dependent on individual technical contributors or executives.

Pre-Sales Strategy, Methodology and Execution

  • Own and continuously evolve the Solutions Engineering methodology across discovery, business and technical qualification, solution alignment, POV/POC execution, and technical close.
  • Establish consistent standards for technical qualification and customer validation, ensuring SE resources are focused on the opportunities with the highest potential business impact.
  • Drive consistent adoption of proven methodologies across countries and account teams while allowing appropriate flexibility for local market dynamics.
  • Establish a metrics-driven operating cadence across pipeline coverage, technical win rate, POV/POC conversion, sales-cycle velocity, capacity, productivity, and other leading indicators.
  • Identify systemic execution gaps and implement programs that improve technical performance, customer experience, and revenue outcomes.
  • Continuously improve the SE operating model through data, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable technical processes.

Revenue and Sales Partnership

  • Partner closely with regional and WW Sales leadership to align SE strategy, coverage, capacity and technical execution with revenue objectives.
  • Establish joint accountability with Sales for technical win rates, pipeline progression, deal velocity, POV/POC conversion and ultimately revenue.
  • Develop technical strategies for strategic accounts, competitive opportunities, and complex enterprise pursuits.
  • Ensure the appropriate level of SE engagement across opportunities based on deal size, complexity, strategic importance, technical risk and customer requirements.
  • Identify technical risk early in the sales cycle and establish mechanisms to proactively address obstacles to closing.
  • Coach SE leaders and teams to connect technical capabilities to customer business outcomes rather than simply demonstrating product functionality.

Product, Engineering and Market Leadership

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to translate customer requirements, field intelligence, competitive insights, and emerging technology trends into actionable product and go-to-market priorities.
  • Establish structured mechanisms for capturing and sharing customer, competitive, and technical intelligence across the organization.
  • Ensure the SE organization maintains deep expertise across Netskope’s evolving portfolio and the broader cybersecurity landscape.
  • Help shape Netskope’s technical positioning, differentiation, and market strategy across SASE, SSE, ZTNA, data security, cloud security, and AI security.
  • Represent the technical voice of the region in company-wide GTM, product, and strategic planning.
  • Create a strong feedback loop between the field, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

AI and Organizational Transformation

  • Lead the evolution of Solutions Engineering to support Netskope’s strategic direction in AI security and the transformation of enterprise security in the AI era.
  • Develop the organization’s technical and consultative capabilities to engage customers on emerging AI security challenges, use cases, risks, and opportunities.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation, data, and intelligent workflows to transform discovery, technical qualification, solution design, POV execution, and SE productivity.
  • Establish scalable mechanisms that enable SEs to conduct deeper customer, technical, and competitive research while reducing manual effort.
  • Drive the adoption of technology and automation that allows the organization to spend more time on high-value customer engagement and less time on repetitive operational activities.
  • Help position Netskope’s Solutions Engineering organization as a strategic differentiator in the rapidly evolving AI security market.

Executive Customer Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and other senior technology executives at strategic customers and prospects.
  • Engage directly in the most strategic and complex opportunities where executive-level technical leadership can materially influence the outcome.
  • Lead or participate in executive briefings, strategic account engagements, customer advisory sessions, and industry events.
  • Coach SE leaders and teams on executive engagement, business-value selling, storytelling, and consultative technical leadership.
  • Represent Netskope’s technical vision and point of view with credibility across customers, partners, analysts, and the broader cybersecurity community.

Job Requirements:

  • The successful candidate is a builder, operator and change leader.
  • They know how to take a strong Solutions Engineering organization and make it significantly better by developing leaders, establishing operating discipline, improving methodology, creating organizational leverage and introducing new technology and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Commercially minded and understand that Solutions Engineering is a critical component of the revenue engine. They can move comfortably between strategic discussions with the executive team, revenue planning with Sales leadership, product strategy with Product Management, and coaching leaders on the execution details required to win.
  • Technically credible without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room. Their value comes from building an organization where exceptional technical talent can consistently perform, grow, and win.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, challenge conventional approaches, make data-driven decisions, and have the leadership presence to influence across a global organization.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Proven executive leadership experience building and scaling large, high-performing Solutions Engineering or technical pre-sales organizations within a high-growth B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, networking, cloud, or technology company.
  • Demonstrated success leading through leaders across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • A strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing SE leaders and building sustainable leadership succession.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and continuously improving pre-sales methodology and operating models rather than simply managing an established process.
  • Strong understanding of modern cybersecurity and cloud technologies, including SASE, SSE, ZTNA, data security, cloud security, and AI security.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology into business outcomes and communicate effectively with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and other senior executives.
  • Strong commercial acumen and understanding of enterprise sales cycles, technical qualification, POV/POC strategy, competitive selling, pipeline management and revenue execution.
  • Experience using data, automation, AI, and technology to improve organizational productivity, scale, and operating efficiency.
  • Exceptional communication, executive presence, strategic thinking, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment while balancing long-term organizational strategy with near-term business priorities.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred. MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.
