title: Executive Protection Agent - FOG
description:
The Basics:

As an Executive Protection Agent, you will join the Executive Protection Field Operations Group, a team of motivated and highly skilled professionals who provide close protection and estate security for the CEO’s immediate family, the Executive Chairman, and other Tanium Executives as needed. Our ideal candidate will be a well-trained and experienced security professional that is proactive, motivated, and customer service oriented.  It is imperative that agents taking this role practice consistent good judgement and maintain the trust of their leadership and those they protect. 

 What We're Looking For:

  • BA/BS and/or equivalent work experience preferred  
  • Industry Experience: Government, Military, Law Enforcement, and/or 5+ years in a security role required
  • Specialty training or experience in Executive Protection and Estate Security required  
  • Industry/Discipline Specific Credentials: 
    • CPR/First Aid/AED required  
    • Valid Driver's License 
    • TX CPL required  
  • Preferred Job Qualifications:
    • Successful completion of a recognized Executive Protection Course preferred
    • Successful completion of a recognized Tactical/Evasive Driving Course preferred 
    • Emergency Medical Technician (BLS (Basic Life Support)) preferred
    • Demonstrated dependability, positive attitude, and good attendance
    • Authorized to work in the United States
    • Water Safety/Open water rescue/ lifeguard training to be completed within 90 days of hire 

What You'll Do: 

  • Incorporate Tanium Mission and Values into all decisions and actions 
  • Responsible for making operational decisions that enhance safety for the principals 
  • Support the Global Security mission, Executive Protection details, and Tanium Executives if needed  
  • Demonstrate effective communication with the principals, visitors, and other team members
  • Be accountable for their decisions, actions, and communications
  • Responsible for safeguarding the CEO, his family, and their private property located at the residence
  • Promote and establish effective working relationships with principals, staff, and team members
  • Support EPFOG new hire and EPPAG cross-training
  • Collaborate on the development of EPFOG standard operating procedures
  • Maintain and input all pertinent info all security logs
  • Effectively perform transports for CEO’s family
  • Ensuring EPFOG vehicles are maintained
  • Receive, document, and communicate all deliveries
  • Serve as the primary point of contact in place of EPFOG Team Lead, when needed
  • Ready and able upon request to support other teams within the Global Security mission to help safeguard Tanium’s people, assets, and reputation
  • Responsible for providing transportation for the CEO’s family upon request
  • Agents must always conduct themselves with Tanium's best interests
  • Other duties as assigned by Head of Executive Protection and Operations
  • Travel in support of the EPPAG
  • Monitor, Track, and assist with all movements of principals
  • Occasionally operate and assist in maintaining CEO boat
  • Occasionally perform duties in a corporate office environment 

Core Competencies: 

  • Ability to adapt and overcome technical and physical obstacles as they arise. 
  • Demonstrates initiative and motivation  
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills   
  • Team player   
  • Person of high ethics and integrity  
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Positive, can-do attitude is necessary 

 Tanium Competencies: 

  • Demonstrates initiative and motivation
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Team player
  • Person of high ethics and integrity
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment 

Work Requirements: 

  • Travel Requirements: 10% 
  • Mental Abilities
    • Analytical abilities: ability to analyze problem situations in depth; ability to show a probing mind.
    • Number facility: the individual must be able to perform basic mathematical calculations at a minimum.
    • Precision to detail: it is necessary that the individual be precise, detail-oriented, and exact.
    • Flexibility: the ability to juggle several projects simultaneously, to cope successfully with diversity and complexity, to integrate seemingly unrelated data, and to reduce complex notions into relatively simple terms.
    • Written and oral communication skills: ability to write memos, letters, and reports in clear, concise fashion with appropriate vocabulary, grammar, and word usage; ability to communicate effectively with superiors, peers, subordinates, and others on a one-on-one basis, using appropriate vocabulary, grammar, and word usage; includes clarity, organization of thought, and expressiveness are all part of this dimension. 
    • Management skills: ability to achieve results through subordinates; ability to successfully recruit, conduct selection interviews, place people, give clear direction, train, develop people for promotion, build cohesive and effective teams, monitor performance thoroughly, give constructive and ongoing performance feedback, conduct annual performance appraisals 
  • Physical & Mental Abilities and Demands
    • Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.  If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for Sedentary Work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for Light Work.
    • Medium work: Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
    • Heavy work: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
    • Very heavy work: Exerting in excess of 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or in excess of 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or in excess of 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
    • Balancing: maintain body equilibrium to prevent falling when walking, standing, or crouching on narrow, slippery, or erratically moving surfaces. This factor is important if the amount and kind of balancing exceeds that needed for ordinary locomotion and maintenance of body equilibrium.
    • Kneeling: Bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knee or knees.
    • Crouching: Bending the body downward and forward by bending leg and spine.
    • Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

title: Field Technologist, Strategic Partnerships
description:
The Basics

The Field Technologist, Strategic Partnerships is a field technical role serving as a primary liaison between Tanium’s Customer Org and Product/Engineering teams for our strategic technology partnerships — hyperscalers and cloud providers (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS), enterprise platform partners (ServiceNow), complementary technology partners (ScreenMeet), and service-provider motions as the portfolio evolves. You will provide technical leadership, support strategic customer and partner engagements, feed real-world input to product teams, and help educate the sales organization on partner value messaging.

You’ll work in a dynamic global environment across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders — from IT and cybersecurity practitioners to senior technical and business leaders — through demonstrations, strategy conversations, roadmap discussions, architecture & design workshops, marketing events, and industry conferences.

What you’ll do

Strategic partnership initiatives

  • Serve as the field technical resource for partner integrations and joint solutions across Tanium’s strategic partner ecosystem.
  • Analyze partner solutions and roadmaps to identify future integration investment opportunities.
  • Engage with partners’ field teams for education, enablement, and opportunity identification.
  • Drive enablement for Sales and the Customer Org: value messaging, demonstration qualification, and opportunity identification across the partner portfolio.
  • Develop demonstration scripts, solution recordings, and field enablement plans spanning multiple partner integrations.
  • Support the technical side of co-sell execution — marketplace transactability, partner-funded programs, and consumption commitments (e.g., Microsoft MACC, AWS EDP).
  • Support Tanium’s field positioning for AI and agentic capabilities inside partner platforms (e.g., Microsoft Security Copilot, ServiceNow AI agents) and how Tanium’s real-time endpoint data grounds partner AI workflows.
  • Present at marketing events, webinars, and partner sessions.

Partner experience

  • Educate and train Tanium partners on technical solution details and cross-vendor solution design.
  • Build durable relationships with partner product, engineering, and field teams so integration issues get resolved and roadmap input flows in both directions.
  • Serve as a technical resource for questions from partner sellers and their customers during joint pursuits.
  • Contribute to joint solution briefs, reference architectures, and partner-facing documentation.

Sales results

  • Participate in senior-stakeholder calls to gather input and shape sales-cycle objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership and sales advisory support; assist with technical pre-sales as SME.
  • Work with the sales team from discovery to close to shorten cycles and improve win rates.
  • Architect technical solutions across IT Operations, Security, and Risk teams; align pre-sales and proof-of-value motions with account goals.

Customer, Product, and Enablement support

  • Help the Customer Org establish value realization of existing investments and drive adoption where partner integrations are underused.
  • Bring field and market insights to R&D and Product; translate field/partner requirements into prioritized integration requests with business case and customer evidence.
  • Test new integrations, represent the field in design reviews and pre-release validation, and help create/test technical competency courses and sales enablement materials.
  • Maintain a current, versioned library of partner integration enablement content.

We’re looking for someone with

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; CS degree preferred.

Experience

  • Working Tanium knowledge or the ability to ramp quickly across the platform.
  • Multi-platform technology partner knowledge — solid expertise in at least one (cloud/hyperscaler or enterprise platform) with working fluency across others.
  • 6-8+ years in the industry with solid technical skills across networking, security, operations, scripting, and/or programming.
  • 5+ years in customer-facing positions; 3+ years in sales and/or strategy-focused roles (consulting, SaaS, global companies).
  • Experience supporting strategic pre-sales opportunities.
  • Hands-on experience with partner co-sell motions — marketplace transactions, partner-sourced/attached pipeline, referral/reseller mechanics, and partner portals and programs.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise AI and agentic platforms and how third-party data grounds them (e.g., Microsoft Security Copilot, ServiceNow AI agents).
  • Experience contributing to field enablement: certification paths, demonstration assets, and train-the-trainer programs.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity as the portfolio changes.
  • Strong critical thinking, judgment, and independence on complex, loosely-scoped problems.
  • Clear communication for senior technical and business stakeholders — workshops, webinars, and partner sessions — with emotional intelligence and influence across extended teams.

Nice to have

  • Advanced technical competency (“blackbelt”) program experience.
  • Experience supporting EBR/QBR activities or contributing to Enterprise License Agreement (ELA) opportunities.

  • Travel: ~25% to engage with customers, partners, and prospects and to participate in events.

description:

We’re looking for an excellent strategic and operational thinker to drive growth, scalability, and efficiency in Tanium salesforce. This person will be in a highly visible role that partners directly with the Senior Director of Sales Operations and Strategy, and collaborates with senior GTM leaders across the world. 

 The right candidate must have the ability to build, inform, think and execute. We’re looking for candidates that can solve ambiguous problems and have the initiative and intellectual curiosity to propose new ideas and recommend solutions. This candidate will roll up their sleeves to dive deep in analyses and models, while also keeping the big picture and practicality in mind. Finally, the candidate will need to have strong business partnership skills, demonstrated by the ability to communicate clearly and build a strong relationship with their business partner.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA; or Reston, VA.

  • Partner with sales leaders and sales operations teammates to analyze go-to-market strategies, resource allocation, and performance at all levels 
  • Assist in the strategic planning efforts for global sales, which include plan modeling, quota assignments, and segmentation. 
  • Take part in leading the operational cadence of all key sales operation activities including forecasting, quarterly business reviews and operational metric reviews 
  • Proactively identify opportunities for accelerating growth through new processes, sales plays, strategies, cross-functional initiatives, SPIFFs, etc. 
  • Create and maintain detailed models to support both short- and long-term strategic planning for Tanium’s growth initiatives 
  • Develop relationships and communicate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders 
  • Serve as the Primary Point of Contact for all Deal Registration process flows and oversight

title: Threat Hunter
description:
The Basics

Tanium is looking for a passionate Threat Hunter to join our rapidly growing team of intrusion analysts tasked with defending Tanium customers and understanding their adversaries. As part of our team, you will bring with you your experience in cybersecurity and threat intelligence to help grow and shape threat hunting at Tanium.  

This role delivers expert‑level threat operations support by strengthening customer incident response readiness, performing hands‑on threat hunting, and enhancing detection and visibility across enterprise environments. It partners directly with customers in a hands‑on‑keyboard capacity to operationalize Tanium, build API‑based integrations, and drive meaningful security improvements. The objective is to elevate customer maturity to a proactive security strategy by combining technical depth, product expertise, and close collaboration with internal teams to address emerging threats and evolving operational needs. 

 

Essential Job Functions 

  • Strengthen customer incident response readiness, assist with remediation planning, and augment response capabilities during incidents to improve overall security maturity and readiness of customers 
  • Perform hands‑on threat hunting with customers, executing the full hunting lifecycle to detect, investigate, and reduce emerging threats 
  • Provide expert deployment and enablement of Tanium Security Operations solutions tailored to each customer’s unique use cases 
  • Conduct threat intelligence analysis, build and refine detections, and tune intel with customers to enhance threat visibility and response 
  • Work side‑by‑side with customers in a hands‑on‑keyboard capacity to guide, support, and maximize the effectiveness of the Tanium Platform 
  • Collaborate closely with internal product teams, providing customer‑driven feedback and hands‑on insights to shape and enhance the Tanium Platform 
  • Build API‑driven integrations with third‑party tools and create custom Tanium hunts using the API to baseline and enhance customer threat visibility and capability 
  • Partner with internal teams to research emerging security challenges—such as AI, container and cloud security, and OT—to inform customer guidance and platform improvements 

 

Minimum & Preferred Job Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, threat hunting, or related defensive security roles 
  • Hands‑on experience performing threat hunting, detection analysis, and investigation work across enterprise environments 
  • Strong knowledge of incident response processes, including scoping, containment, remediation planning, and post‑incident improvements 
  • Experience with security platforms such as EDR, SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms, or similar technologies 
  • Direct customer‑facing experience, providing security guidance, technical support, or operational enablement 
  • Proficiency with scripting or API usage (e.g., Python, PowerShell, REST APIs) for integrations and data‑driven investigations 
  • Understanding threat intelligence concepts, detection engineering principles, and threat visibility best practices. 
  • Ability to collaborate cross‑functionally with product, engineering, and security teams to translate customer needs into actionable improvements 
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics to varied audiences.
  • Language skills; Native-level fluency in Japanese and business-level proficiency in English are both required. 

 

About Tanium 

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate. 

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together. 

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.   

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.  

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

title: Associate Technical Support Engineer - APAC
description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

As an Associate Technical Support Engineer at Dragos, you are the first person customers reach when they need help with the products that protect their critical infrastructure. You provide first-line support for customers' existing environments: triaging cases, resolving common and known issues, and making sure every customer feels heard. This is a fully remote role open across the APAC region.

This is a mission-driven, customer-facing role where how you communicate matters as much as what you know. We are looking for a self-starter who stays calm and clear with enterprise customers and is motivated by what is at stake: keeping power grids, water systems, pipelines, and manufacturing plants safe. Technical depth can be taught here. The communication, ownership, and drive you bring are what set you up to succeed. You can't protect what you can't see, and the work starts with the people who answer the call.

Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as the primary contact for incoming support requests across email, chat, phone, and ticketing, communicating clearly and professionally with enterprise customers throughout the life of each case.

  • Triage cases by severity and impact, then troubleshoot and resolve common, known issues in customers' existing environments using documented solutions, prior cases, and established fixes.

  • Use AI tools to work cases faster by drafting responses, summarizing case histories, and surfacing relevant knowledge, while verifying their output and maintaining ownership of every case.

  • Escalate complex issues to Tier 2 and Tier 3 while staying on the case. Dragos uses a hybrid tiered-and-swarming model, so you keep context, help drive resolution, and learn directly from each escalation rather than handing the case off.

  • Document each case thoroughly so the full picture travels with it: system details, error messages, and steps already attempted.

  • Support routine product upgrades, patches, and configuration changes in established customer environments, following standard procedures.

  • Contribute to the knowledge base as part of resolving cases, using Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practices to write technical content to be reviewed by a peer before it is published.

  • Participate in a team-wide weekend on-call rotation, approximately one weekend per month, to maintain coverage for time-sensitive issues.

Qualifications: 

  • Excellent communication skills: clear, calm, and professional with enterprise customers, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. This is the heart of the role.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a methodical, curious approach to driving issues to resolution.

  • A self-starter mindset, with ownership and genuine motivation for the mission of protecting critical infrastructure.

  • 1 to 3 years in technical support, IT, or a customer-facing technical role, or equivalent demonstrated ability.

  • Working familiarity with the Linux command line and core networking concepts, or the drive to learn them quickly.

  • Comfort using AI tools day to day, with the judgment to verify their output and the understanding that the engineer, not the tool, owns the result.

Compensation: 

  • Salary:  S$ 70,000
  • Competitive Equity Package  
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit www.bugcrowd.com.

Job Summary

At Bugcrowd, we handle application security assessment at an epic scale. As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) you will curate and manage the incoming security vulnerability submissions to some of the world’s biggest companies’ bug bounty programs. Here are just a few of the reasons why we are the best:

  • A tenure at Bugcrowd often means you have worked on not only one company’s security program but potentially on hundreds.
  • As an ASE at Bugcrowd you will be exposed to the Internet’s best security researchers and their cutting-edge security testing methodologies. Our ASEs quickly become technically fluent in obscure/complex XSS, SQLi, XXE, IDOR, SSTI, SSRF, and many other vulnerability types. There is no other organization that offers the learning opportunity that Bugcrowd does.
  • You will be exposed to things outside of your comfort zone. We routinely run security programs for cars, IoT devices, embedded systems, mobile applications, and more!
  • We have an awesome team and tons of perks. We’ve even been selected as one of “The 10 Coolest Security Startups Of 2016” by crn.com.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

An ASE is responsible for the ongoing triage and validation services of Bugcrowd managed programs. Under the direction of the Director of Technical Operations, you will take incoming submission data and curate it for validity, accuracy, and severity as well as communicate directly with Bugcrowd’s clients or researchers when additional information is required. ASEs also handle Incident Response – escalating and communicating about the highest severity bugs to clients. ASEs need to have strong knowledge of OWASP Top Ten type vulnerabilities. They also usually require a strong skill set in one scripting/development language, often to assist with the design or development of tooling for improving the triage/validation process.  The ASE position is perfect for security professionals looking to take their skills to the next level. 

Education, Experience, Skills, & Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree or previous security consulting experience
  • Published and demonstrated passion for security assessment research
  • High proficiency with Burp Suite (or any other interception proxy) and a working level of experience with other industry standard tools (nmap, sqlmap, anything included in Kali Linux)
  • Ability to execute on individual projects but still contribute to the team
  • Ability to complete tasks on time
  • Strong organization, influencing, and communication skills

Sitting and/or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time

title: Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit www.bugcrowd.com.

Job Summary

The Bugcrowd RL and Reasoning Team focuses on pushing the boundaries of autonomous cybersecurity by building authentic, verifiable reinforcement learning environments for world-leading foundational AI companies. As a Reinforcement Learning Engineer specializing in Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), you will design and scale automated verification pipelines that transform real-world software vulnerabilities into deterministic reward functions. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low-level security analysis and modern LLM reasoning models, engineering environments where AI agents learn to discover, exploit, and remediate software vulnerabilities with mathematical certainty. Instead of relying on subjective human feedback, your work directly powers the rigorous, verifiable reward signals that teach next-generation frontier AI models how to master complex cybersecurity domain logic. You will work at the intersection of fuzzing, dynamic program analysis, system exploitation, and scalable ML infrastructure to shape the safety and offensive/defensive capabilities of future artificial intelligence. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Design, build, and deploy high-throughput RLVR (Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards) environments that evaluate LLM action sequences against deterministic execution outcomes.
  • Develop automated test harnesses, sandboxes, and verification engines that convert complex vulnerability research (e.g., memory corruption, web security, logic bugs) into binary pass/fail reward signals.
  • Integrate Bugcrowd’s Mayhem automated analysis platform and real-world vulnerability feeds into continuous, scalable RL environment generation pipelines.
  • Architect safe, isolated, and highly reproducible execution environments (using Docker, BuildKit, or Nix) capable of running thousands of simultaneous agent-driven exploitation and patching trajectories.
  • Collaborate directly with researchers at frontier AI labs including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Cohere to define standard benchmark formats, observation spaces, and verifiable evaluation metrics for cybersecurity tasks.
  • Implement precise telemetry, ground-truth verification algorithms, and trajectory logging to analyze agent reasoning paths and prevent reward hacking or false positives.
  • Build low-level instrumentation and debugging tools to monitor memory states, process executions, and network behaviors during agent interaction cycles.
  • Optimize infrastructure performance and environment reset latency to support massive-scale parallel sampling and distributed RL training workflows.
  • Benchmark and evaluate frontier AI model performance across diverse offensive and defensive security challenges, such as automated fuzzing, exploit payload generation, and patch validation.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Understanding of RL training workflows used by modern LLM systems, specifically execution-based feedback or Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR).
  • Proficiency developing applications in Python and low-level systems programming in C, with Rust experience being a strong plus.
  • Solid understanding of software vulnerabilities, binary exploitation, fuzzing methodologies, or program analysis.
  • Experience with DevOps pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), reproducible builds (Docker, BuildKit, Nix), and comfort working with Linux systems and low-level debugging.
  • Experience working with or building benchmark environments (e.g., CTFs, SWE-bench, security challenges, or execution sandboxes).

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing custom reward functions, ground-truth verifiers, or automated grading engines for AI safety and reasoning models.
  • Background in low-level program analysis tools, sanitizers (e.g., ASan/MSan), compiler instrumentation, or automated exploit generation tools.
  • Proven track record of participating in or developing competitive cybersecurity benchmarks, CTFs, or open-source AI evaluation frameworks.

title: Distinguished Software Engineer, AI
description:
About SecurityScorecard:

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint. 

Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.”  SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:

We're starting a new engineering team, and its job is to change how SecurityScorecard builds software. You'll be one of the first people on it.

The team works out how a company our size should ship code now that agents can write most of it. That means real work on the codebase: running agentic coding workflows end to end, finding where they break, building the tooling and guardrails that fix those breaks, and turning what works into the way the rest of engineering operates. We'll pick product areas to test against as we go. Over time the team takes on real product ownership and folds back into the wider engineering org.

We want strong engineers who went deep on AI coding because they couldn't leave it alone. You know how production systems fail and you've pushed agentic tools far enough to know where they still fall short. You also care about building a team you'd want to work on, and you'll stick around after the novelty wears off.

This is greenfield. You'll report to our CTO or to an engineer leading the team, and the reporting lines will move as the team grows. If titles and org charts matter a lot to you, this role won't be a good fit. We care about execution and impact.

What you'll do

  • Run agentic coding workflows on production code and find out what actually holds up at our scale
  • Build the tooling, guardrails, evals and review practices that let agents ship code we trust
  • Design systems that stay sound when most of the code is written by agents, and decide where humans need to stay in the loop
  • Ship real changes to our products, using them as test cases for the new way of working
  • Pair with engineers across the org, review their work and help them adopt what we learn
  • Raise the hiring bar: interview candidates and help decide who joins the team
  • Write down what we learn so other teams can use it without us in the room
  • Design, build, and ship customer-facing AI-powered product features using TypeScript, Go, and AWS, owning quality and reliability end-to-end
  • Architect and implement agentic workflows, LLM pipelines, and intelligent automation that help customers surface faster, more actionable security insights
  • Integrate foundation models into existing product surfaces with a practical eye toward latency, cost, output quality, and evaluation
  • Use AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, setting the standard for how this team builds
  • Lead architecture and code reviews with a focus on production-grade reliability, security, and maintainability
  • Own projects end-to-end from concept through production, including monitoring, iteration, and improvement post-launch
  • Stay current with the AI tooling and foundation model landscape and bring relevant advances into our roadmap and practices

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years building and shipping production software, with a track record at strong engineering companies (big tech, high-growth startups, or both)
  • Evidence that you drove things. We want the people who set the direction on their teams, not the ones who rode along.
  • Deep computer science and system design fundamentals. You can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and explain how it fails.
  • Heavy, hands-on use of AI coding tools on real codebases, with opinions about what works and what doesn't
  • Experience building with LLMs: agents, tool use, evals, prompt, and context design
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and strong backend engineering fundamentals
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a team that changes shape. You'll help define the job as we go.
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production deployment practices
  • Clear, direct communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our tech stack

TypeScript / JavaScript, Go, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL

How we interview:

Expect a system design round, a coding exercise where you're expected to use AI tools, and a deep dive into a project you led, including how you used AI on it. We'll ask follow-up questions until we understand the decisions you made and why.

Location and compensation:

Remote. We're hiring across United States, Canada, and Latin America.

Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits. 

  • For candidates based in U.S. locations, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $350,000-$400,000 USD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.
  • For candidates based in Canada, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $400,000-$500,000 CAD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.
  • For candidates based in Argentina/Brazil, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $175,000-$250,000 USD, all base salary. This role also includes a substantial equity grant on top of cash compensation.

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

What Expel can do for you:

  • Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.
  • Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.
  • Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
  • Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.
  • Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.
  • Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

What you can do for Expel:

  • Own the customer onboarding journey. Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.
  • Bring customers live with confidence. Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.
  • Help customers get the most out of Expel. Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.
  • Keep implementations moving. Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Get ahead of potential issues. Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.
  • Make customer transitions seamless. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.
  • Help us continuously improve. Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.
  • Support the broader team. Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

What You Should Bring With You

  • 2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.
  • A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.
  • Understanding of enterprise security best practices and common compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.
  • The technical troubleshooting skills to trace data flows, identify integration issues, and work through challenges between a customer's environment and Expel's platform.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for security practitioners, business stakeholders, and customers.
  • Experience managing multiple customer implementations or technical projects simultaneously, keeping priorities organized and timelines on track.
  • The confidence to set expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and hold customers accountable while maintaining positive relationships.
  • Good judgment around when to troubleshoot independently, when to escalate, and how to adapt when a customer's environment doesn't fit the standard playbook.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD, with a target range of $104,000 to $126,500, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

A Technical Support Engineer provides technical support and consultation to customers and colleagues. They are essential in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, providing timely resolutions, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

This position focuses on responding to, owning, and resolving users' technical queries.

Schedule: This role works a four-day work week which includes one weekend day (either Wednesday-Saturday or Sunday-Wednesday, 9:00AM - 7:00PM Eastern time) to support our global follow-the-sun coverage, with weekday shifts worked alongside the broader Support team and the weekend shift coordinated with other regional shifts. Tines will consider requests for reasonable accommodation, including for religious observance. 

What you will be doing

  • Handling technical inquiries received across multiple channels (Slack, in-app chat, and email), maintaining high standards for responsiveness and ticket hygiene
  • Troubleshoot customer inquiries, including but not limited to API integrations, systems issues, network and security-related impediments, 3rd party integrations, and multi-product workflows
  • Resolve product or service problems by exploring the client's request, determining the cause of the problem, and selecting and explaining the best solution to solve the problem
  • Interpreting API documents and creating Tines workflows
  • Configuring and implementing authentication types like OAuth and JWT
  • Documenting the steps needed to connect to new tools or document any new workflows
  • Building, troubleshooting, documenting, and modifying workflows on remote sessions with customers
  • Building strong relationships with other team members within Support and the wider company, acting as the voice of the customer, and maintaining continuity with the team's priorities and open issues despite working outside standard team hours for part of the week
  • Contribute to Customer Support resources and deliver meaningful product feedback as the voice of the customer to leadership and relevant internal teams
  • Proactively identifying improvements to the product, bugs, and otherwise determining high-impact opportunities to enhance the customer experience
  • Writing clear, structured handover notes at the start and end of each shift so incoming and outgoing regional teams have full context with no gaps
  • Making independent judgment calls on prioritization, troubleshooting approach, and escalation while working solo during unsupervised weekend hours, including recognizing when an issue requires paging an on-call engineer or escalating outside normal hours

What you will bring to the role

  • 2+ years of technical support experience within a SaaS environment, ideally in automation or a related field
  • Practical experience constructing, testing, and debugging REST and GraphQL API requests, using developer documentation and SDK examples to understand and troubleshoot integrations
  • Exposure to implementing or troubleshooting AI actions and agentic workflows, including LLM APIs, prompt structures, and protocols such as MCP
  • Experience troubleshooting in a web-based environment, including HTTP, SSL, and basic networking
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, including clear written communication for handover documentation given the reliance on asynchronous handoffs with other regional shifts
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical and technical stakeholders alike
  • Experience handling inbound technical customer requests in various form channels (chat, email)
  • A proven track record of customer empathy, urgency, and technical competency
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented with excellent organizational and time management skills and a consistent quality bar whether working alongside the team or solo
  • Familiarity with at least one modern programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, or Ruby
  • Familiarity with query languages such as SQL, and GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, make sound decisions without direct supervision, and exercise good judgment on when to escalate versus solve independently
  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed problem-solving, including researching solutions independently using documentation, runbooks, and prior tickets
  • Resilience and composure when handling difficult technical or customer issues without immediate backup or a second opinion
  • Ability to context-switch effectively between collaborative, team-based work (weekdays) and independent, self-directed work (weekends) without losing continuity

Desirable Experience

  • An understanding of computer networking principles (Firewalls, Network Protocols, Subnetting)
  • Experience supporting customers using AI and experience with leveraging AI to increase professional effectiveness
  • Fluent Spanish
  • Tines certification
  • Familiarity with Docker containers, Postgres, Redis/Valkey, load balancers, and cloud orchestration platforms (AWS, Azure, GKE, OpenShift), sufficient to triage and troubleshoot

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $85,000 – $95,000 per year. This range reflects our good-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, and location.

Benefits

Tines offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan with employer match; paid time off and paid holidays; paid sick leave; paid parental leave; and life and disability insurance.

  • Bring people into the story: Work with builders, leaders, and teammates across Tines, as well as external SMEs, helping them feel prepared and comfortable sharing their expertise on camera.
  • Capture moments that matter: Produce video at selected events and turn footage into content with a life beyond the event itself.

What you bring with you:

  • Experience: 5+ years producing video content, with examples that show strong storytelling and technical execution.
  • Editorial initiative: You’re curious, have a nose for a good story, and can proactively find and pitch video ideas that will matter to our audience.
  • Project management: Experience managing multiple video projects at once, coordinating with freelancers or agencies, and adapting as priorities change.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

The Executive Assistant at Ping Identity provides high-level administrative support to executives and senior leadership. This role requires a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented professional who can effectively manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and maintain strict confidentiality. This individual plays a critical role in facilitating efficient communication, managing calendars, coordinating meetings, and handling various administrative tasks to ensure smooth operation of the executive office. 

You Will: 

  • Act as a trusted partner and provide comprehensive administrative support to executives and senior leadership.
  • Manage complex calendars, schedule meetings, coordinate travel arrangements, and handle logistics for internal and external events.
  • Proactively identify and prioritize time-sensitive matters, ensuring that executives are well-prepared and informed for meetings and appointments.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, screening and directing inquiries, and providing timely and professional responses.
  • Prepare and edit correspondence, presentations, and reports, ensuring accuracy and adherence to company standards.
  • Assist in the preparation of materials for board meetings, executive presentations, and strategic initiatives.
  • Conduct research, gather data, and provide analysis to support decision-making processes.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion and professionalism.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and department heads to facilitate effective communication, information sharing, and coordination of projects.
  • Anticipate needs and proactively identify opportunities for process improvements, streamlining administrative tasks, and increasing efficiency.

You Have: 

  • 5+ years of executive-level administrative support experience, in a fast-paced corporate environment.
  • Experience supporting C-level executives, ideally within GTM.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accuracy while handling multiple tasks.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficiency in using productivity tools, including the Google Suite (bonus points for leveraging AI in the EA function). 
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and handle sensitive information.
  • Proactive mindset with a problem-solving orientation and the ability to work independently.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and work effectively with a diverse range of individuals.

Salary Range: $105,000 - $125,000 

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This role will be a key contributor to our overall sales and business development strategy as we look to continue maturing our partner network to ensure sustained growth across Europe and build out our partner capability in a number of other developing markets.

As a Partner Sales Engineer, you will have the opportunity to not only enable partners but also work alongside them and support them as they go to market with Ping Identity solutions. In this capacity, you will build and exercise deep technical and consultative skills while leveraging soft skills to maintain engagements and keep them moving forward. Collaboration is at the heart of this role; you will need to exercise consultative skills to rapidly understand an identity problem, prototype a full-stack solution, and implement this as a reusable asset that can be leveraged to accelerate partner-led engagements.

Expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies coupled with insight into System Integrators’ unique needs, all matched with Ping Identity’s visionary capabilities, will enable the presentation of uniquely innovative and effective solutions that will enhance customer success with Ping Identity.

The Revenue Operations Analyst is a strategic individual contributor who supports channel leadership through partner performance analytics, KPI reporting, executive materials, and operational planning. This role turns partner data into insight, strengthens channel business cadence, and helps leadership make better decisions about partner-led growth.

 

The analyst will support channel/sales operations reporting and data, including partner pipeline and deal registration, partner program performance, and partner revenue forecasting. This role partners closely with Channel, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to keep partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue measured on consistent definitions.

Revenue Operations

  • Build and maintain partner dashboards and recurring reporting for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, attainment, and partner productivity
  • Support partner program operations, including tier, incentive, and onboarding metrics, to track program performance and partner readiness
  • Manage deal registration and partner opportunity data to ensure partner-sourced deals are accurately attributed from registration through close
  • Analyze partner coverage, activity, and productivity to identify under-engaged partners, pipeline gaps, and enablement opportunities
  • Support partner revenue forecasting by analyzing partner pipeline trends and reconciling partner-reported results against Salesforce and finance data

Governance and Cross-Functional

  • Partner cross-functionally with Channel, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to improve processes, reporting standards, and decision quality
  • Document data definitions, attribution rules, and reporting logic so that partner metrics are consistent and auditable
  • Operate independently, recommend actions, and help raise the standard of analysis across the team

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in Channel Operations, Partner Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, or a similar analytical role
  • Advanced Excel, Google Workspace, and PowerPoint skills
  • Experience with Salesforce, Anaplan, Tableau, or similar systems

description:

Reporting to the Sales Director, the Sales Specialist is a field-based position dedicated to driving the adoption of our cutting-edge PingOne Recognize biometric authentication technology. Unlike a traditional generalist role, you will act as a subject matter expert, focusing on net-new logo acquisition and strategic upsells by positioning PingOne Recognize products as the gold standard for passwordless, zero-trust environments. You will leverage a robust internal resource model and global partner directory to displace legacy MFA and revolutionize how enterprises handle digital trust.
 
You will:
  • Lead the Passwordless Revolution: Create and execute a territory strategy specifically designed to evangelize PingOne Recognize, targeting organizations burdened by legacy MFA and high-friction authentication.
  • Master the Value Prop: Articulate the unique technical and business value of PingOne Recognize—privacy-preserving biometrics, zero-knowledge architecture, and the elimination of credential-based attacks.

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: Highly competitive base salary, realistic quota design, and transparent commission structure.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Strategic Account Executive to join Ping’s Federal sales organization. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Accounts, the Strategic Account Executive is responsible for driving new business while expanding the right existing relationships, helping customers solve complex identity challenges tied to security, digital experience, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role works across technical and executive buying groups and partners closely with cross-functional teams to turn identity priorities into measurable business outcomes. This draft follows Ping’s internal job description guide and reflects internal role signals showing a strategic team structure, strong new-logo expectations, and solution positioning across workforce, customer, and embedded identity use cases.

You Will

  • Own a strategic portfolio of enterprise accounts and build account plans that create, advance, and close high-value opportunities across enterprise, commercial, and technology organizations.
  • Generate pipeline through targeted prospecting, account prioritization, executive outreach, partner collaboration, and disciplined territory planning, with a strong emphasis on landing new logos.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close, aligning Ping’s solutions to customer priorities around risk reduction, cost reduction, and improved digital experiences.
  • Position Ping’s identity platform across workforce, customer, and embedded use cases, including opportunities where technology companies integrate identity into their own products and experiences.
  • Build trusted relationships with security, IT, digital, product, operations, and executive stakeholders to shape buying consensus and move opportunities forward.
  • Partner closely with Sales Engineering, leadership, customer-success teams, and channel partners to develop account strategy, validate solution fit, and deliver a strong customer experience.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and account hygiene while operating with strong inspection, prioritization, and execution discipline.
  • Represent Ping with credibility in the market by connecting industry challenges to clear business value and differentiated identity outcomes.

You Have

  • 7+ years of successful enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or identity sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota in complex sales environments.
  • Experience selling into enterprise accounts, including commercial enterprises, technology companies, or adjacent regulated industries.
  • A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline and win net-new business through strategic prospecting and account planning.
  • Success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that involve technical buyers, business leaders, and executive sponsors.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical capabilities into value tied to revenue, efficiency, risk reduction, or customer experience.
  • Excellent communication, discovery, negotiation, and forecasting skills.
  • A disciplined, self-directed working style with strong prioritization and follow-through.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience selling identity, access management, CIAM, IGA, MFA, fraud, or verification solutions.
  • Familiarity with industry dynamics, including digital user or customer experiences, regulatory considerations, and security requirements.
  • Experience with platform, embedded, OEM, or ISV sales motions.
  • Experience working with strategic partners, GSIs, or channel ecosystems in enterprise accounts.
  • Knowledge of modern identity trends such as passwordless authentication, decentralized identity, or behavioral and risk-based security models.

With a passion for Ping products and services, the Technical Enablement Associate will support the development and delivery of technical enablement for Ping’s Sales Engineering organization, Partner Pre-sales, and other sales-aligned Go-to-Market teams. This role combines hands-on work with demo and proof-of-concept environments, technical content, product workflows, and learning experiences with project coordination and operational support for our Technical Enablement program. The successful candidate will help configure and troubleshoot technical environments, create clear and reusable enablement materials, support live and virtual events, and continuously improve the learner experience. They will work closely with Technical Enablement Architects, the Technical Enablement Program Manager, Sales Engineering, Revenue Enablement, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders. This role is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious, highly organized, enthusiastic individual to build depth in identity and access management while developing practical program-management skills.

You will:

  • Learn Ping products and foundational identity and access management concepts, and apply that knowledge to technical enablement activities.
  • Configure, test, refresh, and troubleshoot demo, lab, and proof-of-concept environments; document setup steps, known issues, and repeatable processes.
  • Create, update, and repurpose technical enablement materials, including quick-start guides, lab instructions, technical walkthroughs, presentations, and recorded content.
  • Execute defined test cases, validate product workflows, document defects or gaps, and communicate findings clearly to technical stakeholders.
  • Support onboarding, training sessions, workshops, and other live or virtual enablement events through demos, hands-on exercises, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Support the Technical Enablement Program Manager with task tracking, schedules, meeting preparation, content publishing, program documentation, reporting, feedback collection, and other operational activities.
  • Work hours generally align with 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday; flexibility outside these hours may be required due to Ping’s global business, and minimal travel for events may be required, up to 10%.

You have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or 5+ years of equivalent experience.
  • 1+ years of experience in customer-facing or communication-focused roles.
  • Basic programming or scripting experience in a language such as Python, JavaScript, Java, Bash, or PowerShell, with the ability to write or modify simple scripts.
  • Foundational knowledge of information technology, cybersecurity, AI, cloud concepts, web applications, APIs, or identity and access management.
  • Practical AI fluency, including experience using AI tools to improve productivity, research and synthesize technical information, and create or refine technical enablement materials, along with a conversational understanding of common AI terminology and concepts.
  • The ability to follow technical procedures, troubleshoot using logs and documentation, identify and communicate issues, and escalate blockers appropriately.
  • Strong communication, organization, attention to detail, collaboration, and ownership, with the energy, initiative, commitment, and passion to learn; ability to build peer support and strong internal relationships; and an understanding of adult learning principles and program effectiveness measurement.

You have an advantage if:

  • You have exposure to SSO, MFA, orchestration, identity governance, authorization, identity verification, identity risk, or related IAM concepts.
  • You have built or supported demos, labs, sandboxes, proof-of-concept environments, technical workshops, or hands-on exercises.
  • You have experience in technical enablement, sales engineering, software development, IT, cybersecurity, technical support, lab operations, or a related area.
  • You have experience with REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, browser developer tools, command-line tools, basic SQL, or Git.
  • You have created technical documentation, diagrams, presentations, videos, or learning materials for technical audiences.
  • You are familiar with learning platforms, content repositories, project-management tools, reporting dashboards, collaboration tools, Agile, or Scrum.

title: Account Executive – Sales Talent Pool: Register Your Interest
description:
We’re always keen to hear from talented sales professionals. This is not a current vacancy, but if you’d like to be considered for future opportunities at Bitwarden, register your interest and we’ll contact you if a suitable role opens.

About Bitwarden
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Our password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey solutions make it easy for everyone to extend robust security across their devices. Bitwarden is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, with a team located across the globe.

What our Account Executives do

  • Own a territory and an assigned quota, closing new business with a focus on organisations of 1,000+ employees
  • Prospect effectively and manage lead flow to build a strong pipeline (typically 3–5x coverage)
  • Manage and forecast the pipeline accurately in our CRM
  • Build territory plans that deliver both short-term and long-term revenue
  • Recruit, onboard and grow channel partners, including resellers, MSPs, VARs and integrators, and build joint business plans with measurable goals
  • Work closely with marketing on events, programmes and campaigns that create demand among partners’ customers
  • Keep sales leadership informed on channel pipeline and forecast

Who we’d love to hear from

  • 4–8 years of SaaS sales experience in new business or business development. Cyber security experience is a plus but not essential
  • A consistent track record of hitting annual quota, with specific customer wins you can talk about
  • Proven success driving revenue through partners, with strong existing relationships with resellers, MSPs, VARs or integrators
  • The ability to build relationships and influence decision makers at every level of a partner or customer organisation
  • Experience at a startup or high-growth company is desirable
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and can work independently or as part of a team
  • Excellent communication skills: listening, writing and presenting
  • Confident with CRM tools, Google Workspace and Microsoft Office
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • Additional languages are welcome, as some territories may require them

What happens next
 Submit your CV along with a short note telling us where you’re based and the type of territory or role you’re interested in. If a suitable Account Executive role opens, our Talent Acquisition  team will contact you. Our process typically includes a screening call, interviews with sales leadership and the team, and a role play.

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organisations.
  • Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

Bitwarden is dedicated to building a diverse and talented team and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

Privacy: By submitting your CV, you agree that Bitwarden may keep your details, in line with our privacy policy (https://bitwarden.com/privacy/), to contact you about future sales roles. You can ask us to delete your details at any time by emailing privacypolicy@bitwarden.com.

title: Engineer - SDET ( Regression Testing)
description:
Bitwarden is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help the team grow confidently by building a suite of automated regression tests and driving a total-quality approach to software development and delivery. You will contribute directly to the future of the Bitwarden product across web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, CLI, and server components, while working with a great team and an amazing open-source community. This role is primarily for someone strong in C#, test automation framework design, CI/CD integration, and engineering-quality test code.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web, browser extension, mobile, desktop, and CLI applications using C# with Selenium/Appium.
  • Design and implement robust, scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks across multiple application types.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline and ensure their reliable execution in build and delivery workflows.
  • Collaborate with development and QA teams to understand requirements, identify test scenarios, and automate for comprehensive coverage.
  • Execute automated tests, analyze results, and surface defects, performance issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Review test automation code to uphold coding standards, best practices, and maintainability.
  • Establish guidelines and processes for testing community and internal product contributions.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, reporting automation progress, blockers, and upcoming sprint plans.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on automation best practices and frameworks.
  • Document frameworks and processes to support knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability.

What you Bring

  • Strong C# proficiency with substantial production test-automation experience (3–5 years).
  • Senior automation architecture capability: scalable, reusable, maintainable frameworks; readable/testable code; debugging and edge-case handling across multiple application types.
  • CI/CD integration ownership: embedding automated tests into build/delivery pipelines and keeping them stable and trustworthy.
  • Solid command of software testing principles and methodologies, with clear collaboration in a distributed, cross-functional team.
  • Mobile test automation with Appium.
  • Remote/cloud device and browser testing (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, or similar).
  • SaaS, security, identity, privacy, or developer-facing product experience.
  • Experience testing alongside and integrating with backend/API services.
  • Mentoring junior automation engineers and reviewing test code.
  • Experience working in global, distributed technical teams.
