title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative 

About the role

Security and operations teams face more data, more alerts, and less time. Sumo Logic helps them turn that data into action with AI-powered SIEM and log analytics in a single platform.

As a sales development representative (SDR), you start those conversations. You’ll connect with security and cloud operations leaders and practitioners to learn what slows their teams down, and show how Sumo Logic can help. You’ll hand qualified opportunities to our account executives and build the foundation for a successful sales career.

What you'll do

Communication is the heart of the role. You’ll write concise, relevant outreach, lead confident discovery calls, and present Sumo Logic’s value in plain language. You will target personas such as a SOC analyst, a cloud engineer, or a CISO. You’ll adapt your message to each of them and explain technical ideas clearly enough to earn trust, whether you’re on a call, in an email thread, or on video.

 

Research target accounts and identify the right contacts in security, IT, and cloud operations.

  • 80% Outbound / 20% Inbound Focus
  • Run outbound campaigns across email, phone, LinkedIn, and events.
  • Work with Sales AE to assist and support opportunity progression
  • Respond quickly to inbound leads and qualify them for fit, need, and timing.
  • Tailor your outreach to each persona, from CISOs to SOC analysts to SREs.
  • Book meetings and hand off clear, well-documented opportunities to account executives.
  • Record every activity in Salesforce and your sales engagement tools.
  • Partner with marketing, account executives, and sales engineers on account plans and campaigns.
  • Share what you learn from buyers to sharpen our messaging.

 

What you bring - Key Expectations 

The best SDRs listen first. You’ll ask thoughtful questions, stay curious about each team’s challenges, and pay attention to what’s said and what isn’t. That means surfacing the real issues behind alert fatigue, tool sprawl, slow investigations, and rising costs. Then you’ll connect them to how Sumo Logic helps. You’ll capture what you learn and hand it off cleanly, so the next conversation picks up where yours left off.

 

  • Ability to write clear, concise outreach and hold a good phone conversation.
  • Curiosity about security, cloud, and data. You don't need to be an expert, but having a base level of technical knowledge is preferred.
  • Resilience and a willingness to take coaching.
  • Organization and the discipline to follow a process.
  • Comfort with CRM and sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, or similar).
  • [0–2] years in sales, customer-facing, or business development roles. Related experience counts, including retail, hospitality, military, and support roles in and outside of the technology industry.

Preferred: familiarity with SIEM, observability, or cybersecurity concepts, and prior B2B SaaS experience.

Growth at Sumo Logic

You’ll grow quickly here if you’re coachable, resilient, and motivated by learning. You’ll build fluency in SIEM, observability, and the Sumo Logic platform. You’ll also sharpen how you research accounts, prioritize outreach, and refine your approach using data and feedback. You’ll do it all on a collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, and real customer connection.

Structured onboarding on our platform, our buyers, and security fundamentals.

  • Weekly coaching, call reviews, and a clear promotion path.
  • Typical progression: SDR, senior SDR or team lead, then account executive in [12–18] months, based on performance.
  • Access to Sumo Logic training and certifications.

How we work

This is a remote role based from the South East of England. Occasional travel may be required for events, team gatherings, and trainings. All travel must be approved in advance by your manager.

Why Sumo Logic

You’ll sell a product that helps teams stop threats and fix outages faster. You’ll work alongside people who care about the mission and about each other.

The market is moving your way. AI is speeding up both attacks and the volume of data teams must review. Companies need platforms that cut through the noise and point analysts to what matters. Sumo Logic’s AI-powered SIEM and log analytics do that in one platform, so you’ll be talking to buyers actively looking for answers.

The problem matters. Teams can’t defend or fix what they can’t see. Visibility into security, infrastructure, and application data is the foundation of resilience, and a missed threat or slow outage hits the business directly. Your conversations will be about something customers care about.

You’ll build a career. The SDR role teaches discovery, listening, presenting, and objection handling, plus fluency in security, observability, and AI. You’ll work closely with account executives, with clear paths to AE, sales engineering, or leadership.

You’ll join a team that cares. Expect coaching, collaboration, and room to grow, alongside people invested in the mission and in your success.

title: Technical Account Engineer I
description:
Technical Account Engineer - I 

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

About the Role

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

What You Will Actually Do

  • Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
  • Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
  • Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
  • See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
  • Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
  • Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
  • Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

Where and When

  • This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
  • Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
  • You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

What You Will Bring

  • 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
  • Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
  • A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
  • A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See

  • Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
  • A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
  • Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
  • Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

Partner-Sourced Pipeline and Territory Strategy

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline generation and bookings for your assigned territory, in partnership with regional sales leadership.

Partner Activation and Enablement

Measurement and Reporting

Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts.   • Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.

  • Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

  • Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 

What Is The Role:

Location: New York City
Elastic is looking for an exceptional Regional Vice President to lead our Financial Services Strategic Accounts business. This leader will be responsible for a team of experienced sales professionals serving some of the largest and most complex financial institutions in the world across banking, capital markets, payments, and insurance. This is a highly visible leadership role with significant responsibility for growth, customer relationships, talent, and execution. We are looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build and run a high-performing business—not simply manage a territory.
 
You will set the strategy for the region, create and develop pipeline, coach and develop experienced sellers, build relationships with senior customer executives, and personally engage in our most important accounts and opportunities. You will establish a high standard for accountability, preparation, operational discipline, and customer engagement while creating an environment where talented people can do their best work.
 
The right leader understands how to build strategic, multi-year relationships with the world's largest financial institutions and can help customers solve critical business and technology challenges across Search, Security, Observability, data, and AI.
 
You will work closely with Elastic's executive leadership, product, engineering, customer success, partners, and broader field organization to bring the full strength of Elastic to our customers.
 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of experienced Strategic Account Executives responsible for some of Elastic's largest Financial Services customers.
  • Own the overall strategy, execution, and performance of the Financial Services region, including revenue attainment, pipeline creation, account growth, customer retention, and forecast accuracy.
  • Build a culture of high performance, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms across account planning, pipeline generation, opportunity inspection, forecasting, executive engagement, and territory execution.
  • Lead from the front by actively engaging in our most strategic accounts, executive relationships, competitive situations, and complex opportunities.
  • Coach sellers beyond individual transactions to develop comprehensive, multi-year account strategies that expand Elastic's position across customers.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data Officers, infrastructure and engineering leaders, and business executives.
  • Create new pipeline by identifying customer priorities, whitespace, competitive displacement opportunities, and new workloads across Search, Security, Observability, data, and AI.
  • Drive disciplined execution of Elastic's sales methodology and maintain a high standard for opportunity qualification, deal strategy, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate complex enterprise buying environments involving technology, architecture, security, procurement, legal, risk, compliance, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Identify risk early, develop clear action plans, and mobilize the right resources to improve customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Elastic executives and cross-functional leadership to align resources against our highest-value accounts and opportunities.
  • Develop strong relationships across the Financial Services ecosystem, including hyperscalers, global system integrators, technology partners, and other strategic partners.
  • Recruit, develop, retain, and raise the performance of exceptional sales talent.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Elastic's platform, competitive landscape, customer use cases, and the evolving technology priorities of the Financial Services industry.
  • Travel regularly to engage customers, support the team, advance strategic opportunities, and build executive relationships.

What You Bring:

  • A demonstrated track record of building and leading high-performing enterprise or strategic sales organizations in complex technology markets.
  • Consistent success exceeding revenue targets and delivering predictable, sustainable growth.
  • Deep Financial Services experience, with meaningful exposure to major banking, capital markets, payments, and/or insurance organizations.
  • Established executive relationships within Tier-1 Financial Services institutions and demonstrated ability to build new C-level relationships.
  • Experience leading experienced enterprise sellers responsible for large, complex accounts and significant multi-million-dollar customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to create pipeline and build new business—not simply manage an established book of business.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, data leaders, engineering executives, and senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans that expand established relationships into new organizations, workloads, and buying centers.
  • Strong command of complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers, technical evaluations, competition, procurement, security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong operating discipline across pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, account planning, performance management, and inspection.
  • A history of recruiting, coaching, developing, and retaining exceptional sales talent.
  • The ability to coach experienced sellers while holding a high bar for preparation, accountability, and execution.
  • Sound business judgment and the ability to identify problems early, make decisions, and take ownership of outcomes.
  • The ability to translate complex technology capabilities into customer business outcomes and executive-level conversations.
  • The ability to operate with urgency and accountability while collaborating effectively across a highly matrixed organization.
  • A leadership style grounded in high standards, direct communication, teamwork, and a genuine commitment to developing people.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with enterprise Search, Security, Observability, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or AI technologies.
  • Experience working with open source or source-available technologies and communities.
  • Experience building and expanding strategic relationships across Global 2000 or similarly complex multinational customers.
  • Experience developing joint go-to-market strategies with hyperscalers, GSIs, and strategic technology partners.
  • Familiarity with Financial Services use cases including cybersecurity, fraud, real-time analytics, AI, application modernization, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance.

title: Account Development Representative (Join our Talent Community)
description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on

Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.

By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.

Join Our Talent Community: Future Inside Sales Openings

At Corelight, we are always looking for exceptional sales talent to join our mission. While we may not have an immediate vacancy in your specific territory today, we use this 'Evergreen' requisition to identify and vet top-tier candidates for upcoming openings. By applying here, you are entering our priority talent bench for the next available ISR seat.

Role Overview

As an Enterprise Account Development Representative at Corelight, you play a critical role in our revenue engine. Moving beyond traditional lead qualification, you will specialize in Enterprise Account Prospecting, conducting deep-dive research and persona mapping to penetrate the world’s most elite defenders.

You will partner with Field Account Executives and Marketing to build high-value pipelines. This role demands a sophisticated, consultative approach—engaging senior decision-makers with value-led insights. You will develop a deep understanding of their business challenges and articulate how Corelight’s Open NDR platform provides the solution. This is a high-impact position designed for sales professionals looking to master the enterprise sales motion and accelerate their career toward Field Sales or specialized customer-facing roles.

What You Will Do

Following a comprehensive onboarding program with our world-class Enablement team, you will:

  • Execute Strategic Account Prospecting: Conduct rigorous research into Fortune 500 and Global 2000 accounts to identify business drivers, technical environments, and untapped opportunities within our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
  • Master Persona Mapping & Nurturing: Navigate complex organizational hierarchies to identify and map key stakeholders—from SOC Analysts to CISOs. You will build and nurture long-term relationships through consistent, value-led touchpoints.
  • Consultative Engagement: Engage decision-makers through a value-led approach to facilitate high-level conversations about network detection and response (NDR) and data-driven security.
  • Drive Multi-Channel Engagement: Proactively engage executive prospects via hyper-personalized email, strategic social selling, and targeted outbound calls, delivering Corelight’s value proposition with precision and authority.
  • Accelerate Pipeline Growth: Qualify inbound MQLs and convert them into strategic meetings. You will leverage the Pain-Power-Fit-Timeline methodology to prioritize high-intent opportunities and ensure a seamless handoff to your Account Executive partners.
  • Maintain Sales Excellence: Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail by maintaining accurate, real-time records within our tech stack, including Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Who You Are

We are looking for professionals who blend a competitive drive with a strategic, analytical mindset. You should be:

  • Hungry: You are motivated by goals, growth, and grit. You don’t wait for leads — you create them.
  • Consultative: Able to engage in credible, high-level business conversations with technical leaders and executives.
  • Analytical & Creative: Passionate about the "detective work" involved in account research and persona mapping and bring engaging new ways to meet prospects where they are at in the buying process.
  • Resilient: Thriving in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment where persistence and creativity are rewarded.
  • Coachable: Committed to continuous improvement and mastering the nuances of cybersecurity sales.
  • Competitive: You love to win — whether it’s hitting quota, leading the leaderboard, or challenging yourself daily.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 1–3 years of SDR or Inside Sales experience in IT Infrastructure solutions or cybersecurity companies (but we’ll train the right rookie if they have basic sales methodology training).
  • Large account prospecting (Fortune 1000 accounts)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and professional persistence.
  • Experience with Sales Productivity Tools (SalesForce, Sales Navigator, Outreach, etc.)
  • Four-year degree from an accredited university, or equivalent relevant experience

Notice of Pay Transparency:
The compensation for this position may vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. Depending on the nature and seniority of the role, a percentage of compensation may come in the form of a commission-based or discretionary bonus. Equity and additional benefits will also be awarded.

Compensation Range
$60,000—$100,000 USD

Why Join Us? 

Fueled by investments from top-tier venture capital organizations such as Crowdstrike, Accel and Insight, Corelight is one of the fastest growing network detection and response platforms in the industry.  Our passionate team thrives in a collaborative, inclusive, and geographically distributed culture. We embrace diverse perspectives, neurodiversity, curiosity and low ego results - fostering an environment where every innovator can solve the toughest challenges in cybersecurity and contribute their best work.

We are looking forward to meeting you. Check us out at www.corelight.com

title: Associate Escalation Engineer (Overnight Shift)
description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on

About the Role

Corelight is looking for an Associate Escalation Engineer to join our Customer Success organization and provide technical support to customers during overnight hours. This US-based, shift-focused role is part of our expansion toward 24/7 support for Federal customers, helping troubleshoot technical issues, maintain case continuity, and ensure customers receive timely assistance outside standard business hours. In this role, you will work alongside experienced Escalation Engineers to investigate customer issues, build technical expertise, and develop hands-on experience across Linux, networking, hardware, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity.  This role is a strong fit for someone early in their technical career who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and building depth in a highly technical customer environment.

This is a dedicated overnight shift position supporting our expansion to 24/7 customer support.

  • Hours: Overnight coverage between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM Eastern (This is the coverage window, not a 12-hour shift.)
  • Schedule: Potential shifts include Sunday through Thursday or Monday through Friday.
  • Flexibility: Weekend and holiday coverage may be required based on business needs.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate and troubleshoot customer technical issues across Corelight products, Linux systems, networking, hardware, and cloud environments.
  • Support customer cases and take increasing ownership of issues as technical proficiency develops.
  • Use logs, system information, network traffic, and other technical data to help identify the source of technical problems.
  • Learn when and how to escalate complex issues to more experienced Escalation Engineers or Engineering.
  • Provide clear and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders on assigned cases.
  • Build practical knowledge of Corelight products, Linux, networking, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity concepts.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolutions to contribute to shared team knowledge.
  • Partner with Escalation Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Sales Engineering, and other teams to help resolve customer issues.
  • Participate in team training, labs, technical projects, and continuous learning.
  • Contribute to scripting, tooling, automation, and process improvements as skills develop.

What You'll Bring

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Networking, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent technical training.
  • Foundational understanding of computer systems and how devices communicate across networks.
  • Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, IP addressing, and routing.
  • Familiarity with Linux or UNIX systems through coursework, technical training, labs, certifications, military experience, or personal projects.
  • Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.
  • Interest in technical troubleshooting and the ability to work methodically through unfamiliar problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to learn from feedback, ask good questions, and build technical proficiency quickly.
  • Strong technical curiosity and interest in networking, systems, and cybersecurity.
  • Exposure to scripting, packet analysis, cloud platforms, virtualization, or cybersecurity concepts is a plus.

$62,000—$88,000 USD

The Fastly Edge Cloud Platform powers the best of the internet. Our Customer Support Engineering (CSE) team, a key function within our broader Customer Experience organization, helps customers succeed through clear, timely, and transparent technical support.

This opening is for a Customer Support Engineer, Tier I, an entry-level position within our three-tiered team (Tier I, Tier II, and Tier III) that offers multiple opportunities for career development within Fastly. You will work closely with Tier II and III engineers, Engineering, and our customer-facing partner teams, and you will learn our issue management process end to end.

We are seeking a technical problem solver for customers using our delivery and Compute platforms. The role requires a strong understanding of internet protocols and the ability to explain clearly how traffic behaves at the network edge. You will focus on delivery configuration (VCL), caching, HTTP behavior, and the Fastly Control Panel, with growing exposure to serverless Compute. Security product cases (such as WAF and DDoS) and general IT requests are handled by other teams.

What You'll Do:

  • Written-first customer support: Resolve technical inquiries primarily through email and ticket, and also through chat (Slack) and portal engagements. Join live triage sessions by video or phone when a situation calls for it. You will work to define first-response targets, so clear and accurate written communication is essential.
  • Edge troubleshooting: Review customer configurations and debug VCL logic, cache behavior (TTLs, hit ratio), HTTP headers, TLS, and DNS. Over time, build skills troubleshooting Compute (Wasm) applications.
  • Control Panel and account guidance: Guide customers through the Fastly Control Panel, API and CLI, role-based access controls (RBAC), users and permissions, domains, and observability dashboards.
  • Issue management and triage: Assess impact and urgency on every case, work it through our Tier I, II, and III lifecycle, and escalate to Engineering during business hours with clear evidence: what you verified, what you tried, and what you still don't know.
  • Urgent and widespread issues: Recognize when an issue is urgent (for example, customer traffic is down) or affects multiple customers, and engage our after-hours incident response process quickly.
  • Partnering with account teams: Know when to bring in Customer Success Management or Advanced Professional Services, such as when a customer's sentiment is changing or a request calls for configuration review or solution design, and hand off with a clear summary.
  • Customer advocacy and continuous learning: Go beyond closing tickets by educating customers on edge architecture and troubleshooting methods. Share what you learn and contribute to our documentation.
  • Live event monitoring and on-call: Monitor metrics during large network events and proactively report degradation to customers. This role includes an occasional on-call rotation managed through PagerDuty, covering weekends, select after-hours, and corporate holidays (which includes additional holiday pay).

What We're Looking For: 

  • Experience: 2-4 years in a technical support, sysadmin, or network-focused role. 
  • Protocol proficiency: Demonstrated understanding of HTTP/S, TCP/IP, TLS, and DNS, including the ability to explain how a webpage is delivered quickly.
  • Scripting and programming foundation: Working ability in at least one language (for example VCL, Python, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, or Rust) and eagerness to learn VCL and Compute.
  • UI and API literacy: Comfort navigating modern SaaS control panels and RESTful APIs, including from the command line.
  • Customer communication: Strong written communication and analytical skills, with experience supporting customers by email, chat, ticketing system, or phone.
  • Triage proficiency: Working knowledge of network telemetry and diagnostic tools (such as curl and traceroute/MTR), and the judgment to know when to ask for help.
  • Networking fundamentals: Understanding of BGP, internet routing, and the difference between transit and peering.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience, major in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus
  • Experience with Varnish, Varnish Configuration Language
  • Experience in the CDN or cloud computing industries
  • Experience in review/diagnosing log tools (DataDog, New Relic, etc)
  • Basic knowledge of Cloud Platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS)

description:

Fastly is growing its Indirect Procurement team and is looking for an organized, highly motivated Procurement Risk Specialist. This role keeps purchases moving through the procurement risk review process coordinating Procurement, Legal, Security, IT, and Business Systems so every request clears review as efficiently as possible. Working India hours alongside the Procurement Operations Specialist, you'll pick up newly triaged requests and drive their reviews forward so US stakeholders start each day with work ready to advance.

This is a coordination role. You own the momentum, coordination, and visibility of the procurement risk review process; the risk decisions themselves stay with the reviewing teams (Legal, Security, IT, and Business Systems). Your job is to make sure the right reviews happen, on time and to help unblock those reviews when needed.

What You'll Do

Review Coordination & Momentum

  • Take handoff of triaged requests from the Procurement Operations Specialist and initiate the appropriate risk reviews across the Business Systems, IT, Legal, Procurement and Security teams.
  • Act as the single point of contact for each review. You’ll be responsible for starting reviews, scheduling internal meetings, sequencing, and chasing inputs so no request stalls waiting on a next step.
  • Set and communicate aspirational timelines and next steps for each review, keeping every stakeholder clear on what's needed from them and by when.
  • Use the India-hours overlap to advance reviews outside US business hours, so US negotiators and stakeholders begin each day with requests ready to move.

 

Stakeholder Management & Escalation

  • Serve as the connective tissue between requesters and reviewers by answering process questions and keeping everyone aligned on status.
  • Proactively identify stuck or at-risk reviews and escalate them to the Director of Procurement with a clear picture of the blocker and the options to unblock it.
  • Bring the right people together to resolve competing priorities or open questions between teams, keeping work advancing without owning the underlying risk decision.

 

Pipeline Visibility & Reporting

  • Own and maintain the review pipeline tracker as the single source of truth for the status, owner, and age of every in-flight review.
  • Track review turnaround against target timelines and surface bottlenecks, aging items, and trends.
  • Provide clear, regular status updates to the Director and stakeholders, and flag process improvements as patterns emerge.

 

Process Integrity

  • Ensure every request follows the defined intake-to-approval path and that required review steps are completed before a purchase proceeds.
  • Keep review records and documentation accurate and current for audit and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to refining the review process itself as volume and needs evolve.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in procurement, operations, risk coordination, or project/program coordination.
  • Proven project-coordination skills: able to run many concurrent workstreams, hold owners to timelines, and keep momentum across teams.
  • Strong stakeholder-coordination instincts and being comfortable as the person who chases inputs and respectfully holds others to a process.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across departments, levels, time zones, and geographies.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, staying calm under competing priorities in a fast-paced growth environment.
  • Sound judgment about when to escalate and how to frame a blocker clearly and constructively.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
  • A sense of curiosity and a desire to learn every day.

Bonus Points for Experience With

  • Coupa
  • Atlassian Suite (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence)
  • Ironclad
  • Supplier risk, due diligence, or onboarding processes
  • Coordinating cross-functional reviews with multiple departments

  • Experience in a statically typed, modern back-end language (Go, Java, Rust, etc.)
  • Experience in modern front-end frameworks (React, etc.), or a willingness to dive in and become proficient
  • Experience with SQL and database-driven applications
  • Experience working with Linux systems and the shell
  • Experience working with distributed systems or cloud-based services, and an interest in developing deeper expertise in operating and debugging them
  • Comfort with large and unfamiliar codebases: jumping into a system you didn't build, figuring out the context, and contributing with confidence. Our stack is broad, and you will regularly work in code you haven't seen before, including code written at Fastly and open-source codebases.
  • Strong debugging skills: forming hypotheses and narrowing down causes methodically. You’re willing to step outside your primary area of expertise to get to the bottom of something.

  • A desire to grow in your skills, knowledge, and scope. Enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

  • Network protocols and infrastructure, datacenter infrastructure, physical server administration

The HR Business Partner (Global Functional Lead) is a strategic global lead responsible for defining the "what" of the talent agenda for their assigned business functions. Operating within a matrixed global model, this role owns the talent strategy, organizational design, and leadership coaching for their functional client groups worldwide.

The HRBP acts as the primary strategic architect, partnering with Regional HR Leaders (who own the "how" and local execution) to ensure a consistent, high-performance employee experience across all geographies.

Responsibilities:

Functional Talent Strategy & Org Design (The "What")

  • Global Strategic Lead: Identify root-cause business challenges for assigned functions and translate them into a multi-year global HR roadmap.

  • Succession & Talent Reviews: Own the annual global talent review and succession planning process for the function, identifying high-potential talent and bridging leadership gaps.
  • Workforce Planning: Partner with Finance and Functional Heads to lead global headcount planning and talent acquisition prioritization.

Matrix Collaboration (Functional vs. Regional)

  • Regional Partnership: Collaborate with Regional HR Leaders (Americas, EMEA, APJ) to adapt global functional strategies to local legal and cultural requirements.
  • One Voice to Leadership: Serve as the primary point of contact for the function's senior-most global leaders, ensuring they receive coherent and coordinated HR support.
  • Global Consistency: Ensure HR programs (Performance, Compensation, DEI) are implemented with consistency across all regions for the specific function.
  • Operational Handoffs: Manage explicit handoffs to Regional HR for local Employee Relations, compliance, and office-specific culture initiatives.
  • Information Exchange: Ensure vital information is flowing between yourself, the function you’re supporting, and the regional HR leaders. Empowerment through coordination and collaboration is the way!

Leadership Coaching & Performance

  • Executive Advisory: Act as a trusted sounding board and coach for senior executives on people-related decisions, org health, and leadership behavior.
  • Proactive Performance: Partner with Employee Relations and Regional HR to inculcate a high-performance culture, guiding managers on talent assessment and complex performance management.
  • Compensation Strategy: Collaborate with the Total Rewards COE to broker scalable compensation and pay-equity strategies that align with functional benchmarks.

COE & Operational Integration

  • COE Liaison: Interface with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Total Rewards to deliver specialized solutions that address functional pain points.
  • Systems Optimization: Advocate for and help accelerate "Manager Self-Service" and automation in partnership with HR Operations to improve the functional user experience (UX).

Employee Relations Support

  • US Case Support: Partner with Employee Relations to help cover and support any overflow cases (US only). This includes direct work on disciplinary items, investigations, grievance resolution, and offboards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Business, or a related field (Master’s/MBA preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a strategic HRBP capacity supporting global/matrixed organizations.
  • Matrix Navigation: Proven ability to influence across reporting lines—balancing global functional needs with regional operational realities.
  • Outside-In Thinking: Ability to develop HR solutions starting with the business client’s needs and moving toward process design.
  • Strategic Diplomacy: Exceptional communication skills; ability to manage "Functional vs. Regional" tensions and escalate issues via defined protocols.
  • Systems Fluency: Proficiency with Workday and a data-driven approach to HR analytics.

The Professional Services Consultant is a customer-facing consultant responsible for gathering requirements, designing, building, and implementing solutions that enable customers to successfully adopt and operationalize KnowBe4 products.

This role owns the technical journey from discovery through production deployment. Consultants partner directly with customers to understand their business objectives, technical environment, architecture, and requirements. The Professional Services Consultant translates these requirements into a solution design, builds and configures the solution, validates with testing, enables admins with platform knowledge and functionality, and leads the customer through production deployment to successfully hand off to the Customer Success team for continued adoption of the platform.

Responsibilities:

General:

  • Lead discovery sessions with customers to understand business objectives, technical requirements, existing architecture, workflows, integrations, and constraints.
  • Own stakeholder communications throughout the engagement, providing regular status updates and proactively flagging risks or timeline impacts.
  • Identify dependencies, integration requirements, and architectural considerations early in the engagement.
  • Translate business requirements into clear technical requirements and implementation plans.

Implement:

  • Own the solution design for customer implementations and loop in senior members of the Professional Services team as required.
  • Document solution designs, architecture decisions, technical requirements, and implementation specifications.
  • Lead customers through configuration, integration, testing, validation, migration, and go-live activities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical blockers that could impact deployment timelines or solution quality, managing escalation to Product and/or Engineering as required.
  • Validate that the implemented solution meets agreed technical and business requirements, and ensure customers are technically prepared to operate and maintain it post-implementation.

Advise and Enable:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the engagement, helping customers determine how the Knowbe4 platform should be implemented within their environment.
  • Provide necessary API documentation and overview
  • Educate customer administrators and technical teams on solution architecture, configuration, operational best practices, and ongoing management.
  • Conduct technical workshops, solution walkthroughs, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
  • Provide customers with clear documentation and guidance to support long-term ownership of the deployed solution.
  • Recommend improvements or additional capabilities based on customer objectives and observed technical needs.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of industry experience in Professional Services, Technical Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, gained at a SaaS/AI technology company or a consulting firm.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education preferred
  • Familiarity with standard concepts, practices and procedures within the IT Security Field and AI/SaaS technology space
  • Experience working with M365 and/or Google Workspace
  • AI/Saas application, Cybersecurity and IT experience is plus
  • Strong technical discovery and requirements-gathering skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage the technical components of multiple customer engagements.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication and presentation skills.
  • Highly organized and result-oriented

  • Demonstrates integrity, accountability, respect, and commitment

title: Sales Engineer (LATAM) (Hybrid)
description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

The Opportunity
As a Sales Engineer supporting the LATAM region, you'll be the trusted expert who bridges the gap between what prospects need and what our product delivers—turning technical features into clear business value during every sales conversation. Partnering closely with Account Executives dedicated to Latin America, you'll support the end-to-end sales process: conducting engaging product demonstrations in Spanish, addressing technical questions, leading proof-of-value engagements, and helping regional customers understand why our solution is the right fit. The successful candidate is naturally curious about technology, thrives on helping others understand complex concepts, and takes genuine pride in being the technical resource that drives growth across LATAM.

What You'll Do
  • Product Demonstrations: Support sales reps in clear, engaging product demonstrations in Spanish, assisting them in showcasing our platform's features and capabilities to regional stakeholders.
  • Technical Support: Partner with LATAM Account Executives throughout the deal cycle to answer technical questions, address regional compliance or technical concerns, and provide accurate information that keeps opportunities moving forward.
  • Proof of Value Execution: Lead structured POV engagements following established guidelines, working directly with prospect teams in LATAM to set up trials, ensure successful implementation, and demonstrate measurable results that prove our solution's impact.
  • Customer Discovery: Participate in sales calls with strong listening skills to identify technical pain points, understand customer environments across Latin America, and gather the information needed to position our solution effectively.
  • Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot and research basic technical issues that arise during the sales process, escalating complex scenarios appropriately while ensuring prospects receive timely, accurate responses.
  • Sales Collaboration: Support Account Executives by understanding typical sales strategies, contributing technical perspectives during deal planning, and helping translate customer needs into product solutions that win business in the LATAM market.
  • Continuous Learning: Actively participate in training sessions, seek out additional learning resources, and build your expertise in both our product and the broader cybersecurity landscape to grow your effectiveness over time.
What You'll Bring
You're the kind of technical professional who enjoys explaining how things work, stays organized across multiple customer engagements, and genuinely likes being the expert who helps both customers and teammates succeed in a fast-growing market.
  • Language Proficiency: Native or full professional fluency in Spanish and English (both written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex technical presentations, discovery calls, and written communications seamlessly in both languages.
  • Presales Experience: 1+ years of presales experience (or equivalent combination of technical and sales experience), preferably in cybersecurity, SaaS, or technology environments where you've supported customer-facing sales activities.
  • Technical Foundation: Strong technical foundation in cybersecurity or related fields—you understand security concepts well enough to discuss threats, compliance, and technical architecture credibly with IT and security teams in LATAM.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences—you write professional emails, deliver confident presentations, and know how to adjust your message based on who you're talking to.
  • Organization & Ownership: Natural organization and follow-through—you manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously across different time zones, track action items without prompting, and take ownership of commitments you make to prospects and teammates.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong interpersonal skills; you build rapport easily, work effectively alongside sales representatives, and actively contribute to team success.
  • Growth Orientation: You're genuinely interested in developing your skills, welcome feedback, and take initiative to learn new technologies and sales methodologies.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Fluency or working knowledge of Portuguese (in addition to Spanish and English) to further support regional expansion.
  • Experience with regional cybersecurity trends, regulations, or compliance requirements in Latin America.
  • Familiarity with security awareness training, phishing simulation, or compliance management concepts.
  • Experience with mail environments, Active Directory, or common IT infrastructure.
Why You'll Love It Here
  • Career Launch Pad: You'll build a strong foundation in technical sales within a high-growth region, with a clear path for advancement—many of our Senior Sales Engineers and SE leaders started in this role and grew their expertise here.
  • Skill Development: Develop valuable technical and business skills through structured training, certification bonuses, hands-on customer work, and mentorship from experienced Sales Engineers who invest in your growth.
  • Hybrid Flexibility: 3-day in-office environment that balances time with your sales team for collaboration and deal strategy, while supporting the flexibility you need to manage customer calls and demonstrations across LATAM time zones effectively.
  • Customer Impact: Work directly with organizations across Latin America solving real security challenges; you'll see firsthand how your technical expertise helps customers protect their people and makes deals happen.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team environment where experienced Sales Engineers share knowledge freely, sales representatives value your technical contributions, and everyone celebrates wins together.

title: Large Enterprise Account Executive, LATAM
description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About this role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Large Enterprise Account Executive, LATAM to join our dynamic sales team in Brazil.  The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and closing new business opportunities with enterprise-level clients, which are companies with 6,000 employees and above. You will focus on identifying new business opportunities, in addition to land and expand by fostering relationships to maximize opportunities within these organizations.

About your skills:

  • Problem Solving: You are skilled in creative problem-solving techniques to address client needs, overcome obstacles, and drive sales outcomes, ensuring customer satisfaction and business success.
  • Coachability: You demonstrate a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and incorporate feedback to enhance strategies and achieve performance targets, fostering continuous personal and professional growth.
  • Curiosity: You exhibit a natural curiosity and hunger for knowledge, constantly seeking to understand market trends, customer preferences, and competitive analysis to inform strategy and drive business success.
  • Outbound Mindset: You possess a proactive outbound mindset, driven to identify new business opportunities, cultivate relationships with prospects, effectively communicate value and supported by your research and rigor throughout the process.
  • AI Proficiency: You demonstrate strong AI literacy by adopting and mastering new sales technologies—such as GenAI, conversational intelligence, and AI-powered tooling—to drive efficiency. You utilize prompt engineering to create personalized messaging and to gain insight for customer meetings. You leverage data-driven insights from AI tools to craft high-impact pitches for C-level executives.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Identify, prospect, and qualify new enterprise-level business and upsell opportunities within assigned territory
  • Coordinate and work with Udemy Business team (Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, key executives) to ensure territory success; customer satisfaction, expansion and retention
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers to understand clients' business objectives and challenges to effectively position our solutions as a strategic fit
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to meet and exceed sales targets
  • Leverage AI-powered sales technologies, GenAI, and conversational intelligence tools to drive efficiency throughout enterprise sales cycles
  • Utilize prompt engineering to create personalized messaging for large enterprise prospects and generate insights for executive meetings
  • Apply data-driven insights from AI tools to craft high-impact pitches tailored for C-level executives and key stakeholders
  • Lead negotiations and close complex sales deals, ensuring contracts are executed accurately and in a timely manner
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, customer feedback and competitor activities; then relay and share any insights with your team!

Qualifications:

While this work is based more on the skills a person has than what they have done, we think a typical profile could include the following:

  • We are looking for a highly motivated, over-achieving "hunter and closer" who flourishes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • A minimum of 7+ years of closing experience in B2B Enterprise sales (SaaS experience preferred) or equivalent
  • Enterprise-style go-to-market playbook that includes value-based selling and leveraging Value Engineers/Solution Engineers in pre-sales
  • Experience partnering with other Account Executives in an overlay specialist sales model
  • Success in opportunity creation and "full funnel" management of many opportunities
  • Strong AI literacy with experience adopting and mastering new sales technologies in enterprise environments
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering and interpreting AI-driven insights to enhance enterprise sales effectiveness
  • Proven history of exceeding targets in selling licenses/products/subscriptions to Enterprise organizations with demonstrated ownership of all aspects of territory management

 

Compensation

This is a remote role based in Brazil.  The OTE range for this position is BRL 592,000- BRL 740,000.

Mandatory Technical Skills 

  • Strong understanding of AWS Cloud fundamentals and core cloud computing concepts
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, DynamoDB, VPC, IAM, SNS, and Elastic Beanstalk
  • Knowledge of cloud networking, load balancing, autoscaling, and security best practices
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CloudFormation
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and deployment automation tools

  • For concept deep-dives, mentors will come prepared with a slide presentation that reviews a Nanodegree concept in more detail, share different use-cases for the concept to broaden student perspectives and understanding, and hold a Q&A session with the learners.

This can include a mentor “grading” a sample submission to demonstrate what mentors are looking for when reviewing projects.

Group Q&A Session:

  • Host regular sessions (via Slack or video) to address learner queries related to projects and coursework. No prior preparation required.

  • Make an impact by mentoring and contributing to a vibrant, global learning community

title: Backend Engineer, Knowledge Graph
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.

The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.

In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.

What you’ll do

  • Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.
  • Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
  • Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.
  • Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.
  • Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.
  • Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.
  • Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).

This hands-on role brings together infrastructure, automation, and developer experience, helping application teams deploy and operate their services.

What you’ll do

  • Operate and improve production Kubernetes clusters across cloud environments, managing upgrades, scaling, and reliability throughout the cluster lifecycle.
  • Own and extend Argo CD-based GitOps workflows, maintaining ApplicationSets, managing sync policies, and enforcing deployment standards across environments.
  • Write, review, and maintain reusable Terraform modules, with clear practices for state management and drift detection.
  • Monitor platform health, respond to incidents, conduct post-mortems, and improve availability, performance, and observability.
  • Collaborate with application teams to onboard services, and create documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling that improves developer productivity.
  • Implement role-based access control, network policies, and secrets management to meet infrastructure security and compliance requirements.

  • Experience operating Kubernetes in production and working with at least one major cloud provider: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with Argo CD or comparable GitOps tooling, such as Flux.
  • Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning, including remote state, workspaces, and module design.
  • Ability to write scripts and automation in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Familiarity with Helm for Kubernetes package management.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including the Domain Name System (DNS), load balancing, ingress, and service mesh concepts.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document systems and collaborate across teams.
  • Optional: experience with managed, multi-cluster, or multi-region Kubernetes, service meshes, policy as code, observability, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure as code; open source or platform tooling contributions; or relevant certifications.

The Runway team builds and maintains infrastructure and developer tooling for GitLab's engineering organization.   • Support customer adoption of GitLab solutions, proactively work to reduce churn and contraction, and participate in quarterly forecasting and territory planning.

About the Role

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer to lead technical direction across GitLab's Core DevOps services, the systems the majority of our users touch every day. Distinguished Engineers are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the most senior level of technical leadership within and across divisions at the company.

Core DevOps builds continuous Integration, continuous deployment, planning, and source control experiences. These are among the most mature, highest traffic, and most deeply interconnected systems at GitLab. They carry years of accumulated architectural decisions, they sit in the critical path of our customers' own delivery pipelines, and they are being reshaped by the shift toward AI native development. The job is to raise their quality, converge them onto a coherent go-forward architecture, and retire accumulated risk, all without interrupting the millions of users and Fortune 100 organizations who depend on them.

GitLab is pursuing a set of company-wide engineering goals: large gains in developer productivity, measurably higher quality in what we ship, and engineering practices reshaped around AI and agentic workflows. Core DevOps is where much of that strategy has to land, because these are the services our own engineers and our customers depend on daily. In this role you will bring that strategy into Core DevOps in a form that works for long lived production systems, and carry what you learn here back out to the rest of engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Set and continuously refine the go forward technical direction for CI, CD, Plan, and source code experiences, aligned against the horizontal architectural initiatives.
  • Work directly with the VP of Engineering as her technical counterpart on planning, technical investment, and where the group's engineering effort should go.
  • Translate GitLab's company-wide productivity, quality, and AI native engineering goals into concrete technical direction for Core DevOps, and turn into iterable roadmaps, partnering broadly across the org.
  • Define what good means in measurable terms for these services, including availability, latency at p95 and p99, pipeline success rate, test reliability, data correctness, and defect escape rate, then hold designs and implementations to it.
  • Maintain a clear and current picture of systemic technical risk across the group, including single points of failure, unowned critical paths, brittle coupling between CI/CD and Plan, scaling limits, and past decisions that now constrain the roadmap. Drive a prioritized plan to retire it.
  • Lead the hardest design decisions hands on, writing code, prototypes, and proofs of concept where a design argument needs evidence behind it.
  • Drive convergence on shared patterns, libraries, and paved paths, reducing how many different ways the same problem gets solved across the group.
  • Design migration paths that let large, long lived systems change underneath users without breaking them, using incremental cutover, dual run, measurable rollback, and deprecation with clear timelines.
  • Adopt the platform capabilities coming from GitLab's AI organization and the company's productivity initiatives into Core DevOps, feed this group's requirements back into them, and help prove what works on systems of this scale and maturity.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or contested technical decisions across the group, including those where no single team owns the outcome.
  • Review significant designs and merge requests in the group's critical paths, and use review to teach rather than only to gate.
  • Ensure designs hold across GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, and respect multi-tenant, compliance, and data governance boundaries in each.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and SRE so Core DevOps services are observable and debuggable, and so failure modes degrade gracefully instead of cascading.
  • Make architectural constraints and opportunities clear to Product in roadmap terms, so that technical investment and product ambition get planned together instead of traded off late.
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let teams across the group make aligned decisions independently.
  • Grow Principal and Staff Engineers across Core DevOps, raise the bar on design rigor and technical writing, and contribute to the technical hiring bar for senior individual contributors.
  • Participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com, and complete Interview Training to participate in hiring as a technical interviewer or panel member.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in AI and ML systems, including large language models, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflow design at production scale.
  • Proven track record of leading hands-on technical experimentation, including defining evaluation frameworks, running benchmarks, and translating findings into scalable architecture decisions.
  • Strong background in scalable, multi-tenant distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience.
  • Experience designing and implementing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for production systems.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or divisions without direct authority.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization with excellent written and asynchronous communication skills.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.

  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.

  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution.
