title: Account Executive, NAS Product Specialist
description:
About the Team & Role

Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our Unstructured data protection and security portfolio. This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every Unstructured opportunity — from first conversation through technical validation to close.

We're hiring an NCD Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's Unstructured data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on NAS storage architectures, file-generating applications, backup and recovery mechanics, and the security behind protecting these growing assets — and use that fluency to win deals against competitive point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before, at a company like NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, Vast, EverPure, Komprise, Superna, etc.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the NCD product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close NCD data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts.
  • Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik’s NCD architecture, security posture, and the gaps in storage native shared snapshot protection in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers.
  • Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for NCD.
  • Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against competition or "do-nothing", translating technical differentiation into business value.
  • Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize NCD attach and expansion within the install base.
  • Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience.
  • Forecast with discipline: maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews.
  • Stay current: maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik’s NCD roadmap, storage ecosystems, and the competitive landscape.

Experience You’ll Need

  • Storage sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling storage infrastructure (file preferred) with a deep understanding of these technologies.
  • Directly relevant background: experience at a NAS or file storage vendor such as NetApp, Dell, Qumulo, or VAST (or a comparable company like Komprise, Superna, or EverPure) is strongly preferred.
  • Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing NAS architectures (NetApp ONTAP, Dell PowerScale/Isilon, Qumulo, VAST), SMB/NFS protocols, snapshots and replication, file-generating applications, and ransomware and compliance requirements for unstructured data without relying solely on a Sales Engineer.
  • Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery, sizing, and proof-of-concept engagements for storage or data protection solutions, not just handing off to a technical resource.
  • Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across storage and infrastructure teams, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts.
  • Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.
  • Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation.
  • Education: bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise NAS platforms, data management or tiering tools, and backup and recovery workflows for large unstructured data sets.
  • Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans on-premises, cloud, and SaaS workloads.
  • Existing relationships with storage, infrastructure, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts.

title: Employee Relations Partner & HR for HR
description:
Employee Relations Partner & HR for HR 

 

About the role

The Employee Relations (ER) Partner is a hands-on, execution-focused role within the People Team, responsible for running workplace investigations and resolving employee relations matters across Rubrik’s three organisations: R&D, GTM and G&A. This role serves as a trusted advisor to Business Partners, Legal, People leaders and managers, ensuring employee concerns are addressed consistently, objectively, and in alignment with company policies and employment laws. Working with our Business Partners, Legal and People leaders, you will conduct thorough, impartial investigations, provide expert ER guidance, support consistent, risk-informed decision making and deliver clear, well-documented outcomes.

This role also serves as our “HR for HR”: the trusted, impartial point of contact for ER matters involving members of the People Team, providing independent oversight, ensuring those matters are handled with objectivity and confidentiality. You will work to the shared ER case methodology, documentation standards and governance set centrally by the People Team, helping us deliver a consistent employee and manager experience across every function and region.

 

This role helps ensure Rubrik maintains a fair and legally compliant workplace by:

  • Delivering objective, high-quality workplace investigations
  • Providing expert guidance on complex employee relations matters
  • Driving consistency in employee relations practices and outcomes
  • Providing insights that inform policy, process and leadership decisions

 

Reporting line: Senior Director HRBP & dotted line into our Internal Employment Counsel. This is a US-focused role, with opportunities to be involved in or drive aspects of our international ER cases. 

 

What You'll Do:

 

Investigations and case execution

  • Own the end-to-end execution of workplace investigations across R&D, GTM and G&A, including allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation and policy violations: scoping, planning, neutral fact-finding interviews, credibility assessments, findings and recommendations
  • Collaborate with Internal Legal to develop and execute investigation plans, and recommend appropriate resolutions to Business Partners, People leaders and other stakeholders
  • Act as liaison to external counsel and investigators on HR-related investigations
  • Produce clear, accurate investigation reports and case documentation to the standard set by the People Team’s central ER framework
  • Facilitate and support interactive processes with employees seeking a reasonable medical accommodation
  • Contribute ER input to performance and separation matters, supporting consistent, well-documented decisions and helping to mitigate risk
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Claude) to speed up investigation work: drafting investigation plans and interview outlines, summarizing evidence, and structuring reports. A human always verifies accuracy, credibility findings, and conclusions.

 

ER Partnership across R&D, GTM and G&A, and HR for HR

  • Serve as the “HR for HR”: the confidential, impartial ER point of contact for matters involving People Team members, including managing conflicts of interest and escalating to Legal or external parties where appropriate
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and advisor on employee relations best practices to Business Partners, People leaders and the business, ensuring Business Partners can focus on strategic partnership while you lead complex case execution
  • Partner with Legal to ensure consistent interpretation and application of policies and practices across organisations and geographies
  • Identify emerging employee relations risks and organizational trends, partnering with HRBPs, Legal and leaders to proactively address root causes before issues escalate.
  • Contribute to frontline manager development through training and guidance on fundamental ER topics that support a fair and equitable workplace

 

Consistency, insight and continuous improvement

  • Maintain case-tracking systems and reports, using intake and triage tooling consistently so every matter is logged, categorised and resolved against common metrics
  • Use AI-assisted analysis of case data to surface ER trends (hot spots, repeat issues, manager patterns) and turn them into recommendations for senior leadership. 
  • Help build and refine AI-enabled playbooks, templates, prompt libraries, and manager guides. 
  • Partner Legal and COE on policy development and process improvements informed by case outcomes and organizational trends.
  • Participate in key People or business initiatives as required



Experience You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 - 7+ years of direct experience conducting workplace investigations, including allegations of harassment, discrimination and retaliation
  • Proven ability to manage a caseload independently and to a high standard, from intake through to final report
  • Knowledge of federal, state and local laws and statutes governing employment policies and practices
  • Strong understanding and application of workplace investigation best practices and standards, including conducting neutral fact-finding interviews, credibility assessments and maintaining confidentiality
  • Sound judgement and discretion in handling highly sensitive and confidential matters, including those involving colleagues within the People Team
  • Experience supporting multiple business functions (for example engineering, sales and corporate functions) and building credibility with leaders at all levels
  • Excellent planning, organisation and time management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple matters in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment
  • Ability to communicate objectively with employees and management through complex, difficult and emotional issues. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organisation

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with international ER matters and working alongside external and internal counsel
  • Experience using case-management or intake and triage tooling, and reporting on ER trends and metrics
  • Experience in a technology or high-growth environment

title: ENG Project/ Program - Intern
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a highly organised and motivated Project/ Program Manager Intern to join our dynamic team. As an intern, you'll assist in managing our On Prem/Saas  product delivery. You will assist in the planning, managing, and execution of several technical programs and initiatives each year for our Engineering Organisation across our Product portfolio. You will get an first-hand experience in driving the improvement of our processes throughout the development, validation and deployment lifecycle. You will be collaborating with stakeholders and understanding the components of delivering large features/ initiatives and their associated technical complexities. This role will provide you the opportunity to learn how to navigate complex situations while evaluating risks and aligning with business priorities. You will learn to manage tasks while working in a fast-paced environment and developing your technical expertise. Your responsibilities will include assisting in driving metrics improvement, learning to communicate the current status, and helping in delivering features to market.

 

Responsibilities include:

Planning & Execution: 

- Assist in defining program scope, goals, milestones & success metrics

- Develop & maintain project plans, schedules & documentation

- Track project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders

- Create dashboards or reports to track progress, KPIs

 

Coordination and Communication:

- Collaborate with Engineering and Product Leadership and functions such as Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support etc. to prioritize, plan, and deliver new features and products to the market. 

- Assisting in the communication of schedules, status, and issues to stakeholders.

- Assist in running effective and efficient meetings that accomplish goals in a timely manner. 

Risk Management:

- Identifying potential risks and assisting in the development of mitigation plans.

- Collaborating with development teams to aid in addressing and resolving issues that may impact timelines.

Continuous Improvement:

- Recommending tools and methodologies to enhance efficiency and automation

- Document lessons learned and best practices for future projects

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications: 

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. 
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Basic understanding of Software development lifecycle(SDLC) and agile methodologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to learn fast and work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment

Preferred/Nice-to-have skills

  • Exposure to Cloud Platforms - AWS/Azure/GCP
  • Exposure to Storage domain
  • Exposure to Enterprise product development

Minimum eligibility criteria
- CGPA 8 and above
- 2027 graduates of Circuital branches only
- Available from January 2027 to May 2027 in Bangalore for the onsite internship (No remote options)

title: HR Business Partner, Corporate Functions
description:
HR Business Partner, Corporate Functions 

About the Role

We're looking for a new member of our People team who loves all things People! This HRBP role sits within the HR Business Partner team, supporting the Corporate Functions (Finance, Accounting, IT, Infosec and Legal) and Marketing client groups. You'll partner closely with Senior HR Business Partners to deliver a world class day-to-day experience for employees and managers, with a strong focus on employee relations and building the coaching capability of our first-line and mid-level managers. This role will be based in Palo Alto, CA. Onsite 3 days per week. 

What You'll Do

  • Be an AI-native HRBP, not just an AI user. Question how People work gets done today (manager coaching prep, ER documentation, program rollouts) and bring ideas to redesign the workflow around AI rather than just speeding up the old one. Know where human judgment stays non-negotiable; ER, coaching, and sensitive conversations are never handed off
  • Let data not just anecdotes guide how you coach managers and flag emerging people trends and issues
  • Serve as a trusted, go-to partner for employee relations, helping managers and employees work through workplace concerns, guiding them to the right resolution, and escalating complex or sensitive cases to the Senior HRBP as needed
  • Build the coaching capability of first-line and mid-level managers, helping them grow their own people leadership skills rather than just solving issues for them. Covering organizational health, employee engagement, development, and policy interpretation
  • Partner with and support the Senior HR Business Partner(s) on business-specific people initiatives and roadmap execution
  • Support execution of annual people programs (year-end and mid-year performance reviews, talent reviews, compensation planning, engagement initiatives, succession planning) in partnership with the Senior HRBP
  • Partner with Centers of Excellence (Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Talent & Development, DEI, People Operations) to help identify and support process improvements
  • Translate ambiguous people/policy questions into clear guidance and next steps, communicating HR concepts simply and effectively to managers at all levels
  • Support change management efforts at the team level, helping first-line and mid-level managers navigate organizational or process changes with their teams
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to help draft manager communications, summarize employee relations notes, prep for coaching conversations, and speed up policy research and first-pass answers, always with a human review before anything goes to an employee or manager

Experience You'll Need

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, ideally with some generalist or HRBP exposure
  • Experience handling employee relations matters and coaching first-line and mid-level managers through people challenges
  • Foundational experience supporting performance and compensation cycles, manager coaching, or learning & development programs
  • Working knowledge of basic labor law concepts 
  • Strong relationship-building skills, comfortable partnering with managers at multiple levels, peers, and cross-functional HR teams
  • Experience working in or with a global/distributed team environment
  • Comfort using AI tools in daily work to boost productivity, paired with sharp judgment about when human review and empathy matter most
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: HR Business Partner R&D
description:
HR Business Partner, R&D

Location: Palo Alto, CA (3 days in office)

 

We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner, R&D to partner with managers across Engineering, Product, Design, and Customer Support to strengthen manager capability, build high-performing teams, and drive business and talent outcomes.

This hands-on role focuses on manager coaching, performance management, compensation planning, organizational health, and people program execution. As a trusted advisor, you will help managers navigate complex people decisions, improve team performance, and build the capabilities required to achieve business objectives.  You will diagnose organizational challenges, identify opportunities and translate them into practical, high-impact people solutions. You will also help shape the future of HR business partnering by leveraging AI and agentic workflows to improve decision quality, expand HRBP leverage, enhance manager support, and deliver scalable people solutions.

This role is designed for a highly accountable HRBP who thrives in a high-velocity environment, takes ownership of outcomes, has strong bias for action, proactively solves problems, and continuously improves how work gets done.  The ideal candidate combines the judgment of a trusted advisor, the execution rigor of an operator, and the mindset of a builder.

 

Scope of Impact

 

Business Partnership

  • Build trusted partnerships with managers and leaders across supported R&D organizations, serving as a credible advisor on talent, organization, and people-related decisions.
  • Translate business objectives into practical solutions that enable organizational effectiveness.
  • Balance business priorities, employee experience, and long-term organizational implications when advising managers
  • Proactively identify organizational risks, capability gaps, talent concerns, and workforce trends, and drive recommendations that improve business outcomes.

Manager & Leadership Capability

  • Advise first-line and mid-level managers on people leadership, performance management, employee development, engagement, organizational health, and team effectiveness.
  • Identify capability gaps and implement targeted interventions that strengthen manager effectiveness and team performance.
  • Coach managers through challenging employee situations, difficult conversations, performance concerns, organizational change, and development planning.
  • Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and people practices while reinforcing broader organizational considerations.
  • Deliver manager enablement and leadership development initiatives that improve effectiveness and consistency at scale.

Performance, Talent Management and Compensation 

  • Own execution of annual people programs, including performance reviews, calibration discussions, talent reviews, and compensation planning, ensuring high-quality outcomes and strong manager engagement
  • Coach managers through complex performance management decisions and strengthen performance expectations, accountability, and employee development practices.
  • Identify talent, retention, succession, and capability risks and develop mitigation plans with managers 
  • Partner on compensation decisions aligned with company philosophy and leverage workforce insights to improve decision quality.

HR Program Design, Execution & AI-Enabled Transformation

  • Design, implement, scale, and improve people programs that enhance manager effectiveness and organizational outcomes.
  • Simplify, automate, and redesign people processes with a focus on outcomes rather than digitizing legacy workflows.
  • Champion AI, automation, and agentic workflows across HRBP work to improve decision quality, increase capacity, and deliver scalable people solutions and  impact beyond traditional human capacity.
  • Deliver integrated HR solutions in partnership with the broader People team and identify innovative approaches that improve productivity, adoption, and effectiveness.

Organizational Health, Engagement & Development

  • Advise leaders on organizational health, culture, and team effectiveness while strengthening the development, retention, and engagement of key talent.
  • Use workforce sentiment, organizational insights, and people analytics to identify risks, diagnose challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.

Employee Relations

  • Provide guidance and independently manage moderate to complex employee relations matters using sound judgment and risk assessment.
  • Resolve employee concerns in partnership with managers and collaborate with Legal on sensitive, high-risk, or specialized matters.

How You Create Impact

  • Translate complex business priorities into focused, executable people solutions.
  • Influence decisions through expertise, credibility, and practical problem-solving.
  • Demonstrate urgency, ownership, and follow-through while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Leverage data, organizational insight, and systems thinking to diagnose challenges and develop scalable solutions.
  • Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching, development, and enablement.
  • Drive execution of talent, performance, compensation, and people programs that improve organizational outcomes.
  • Navigate employee relations and performance matters with sound judgment and appropriate risk assessment.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to increase impact, productivity, and scale while maintaining an enterprise mindset.

What Success Looks Like

  • Be known for speed, ownership, sound judgment, and turning ambiguous people challenges into actionable solutions.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with managers who proactively seek your guidance on critical talent and organizational decisions.
  • Elevate manager capability, accountability, and team effectiveness across supported organizations.
  • Deliver strong execution of performance, talent, compensation, and people programs that improve business outcomes.
  • Anticipate organizational risks and continuously improve how people work is delivered through AI, automation, and scalable solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3+ years as a People Partner or HR Business Partner, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting R&D client group

title: Information Technology Contract Recruiter
description:
About Rubrik

Rubrik is on a mission to secure the world’s data. As the Zero Trust Data Security™ Company, we deliver data resilience, data observability, and data recovery for cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments. We help organizations keep their data secure, continuously available, and resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions.

We are looking for a high-energy, results-driven IT Contract Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of Rubrik by sourcing, attracting, and hiring top-tier technology talent.

Role Overview

As an IT Contract Recruiter, you will manage full-lifecycle recruiting for a variety of technical and IT positions across the enterprise. You will collaborate closely with IT hiring managers and cross-functional teams to identify candidates who possess exceptional technical skills and align with Rubrik’s high-performance culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Recruiting: Own end-to-end recruitment for complex IT and technology positions, Program Managers, AI Architects, & AI Engineers
  • Sourcing & Pipeline Building: Proactively source passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, industry networks, employee referrals, and specialized technical communities.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner directly with hiring managers to understand team structures, role requirements, and headcount priorities; deliver clear hiring strategies and regular candidate pipeline updates.
  • Candidate Experience: Screen resumes, conduct initial phone interviews, evaluate candidate technical backgrounds, and manage candidate progression through the interview workflow to ensure a world-class candidate experience.

title: Large Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Large Enterprise Account Executive, Japan

Rubrik’s Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity  through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.
 
As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll own new logo growth across Japan’s large enterprise market, with the autonomy to shape your territory and the backing of a global team and a world-class enablement program to take your career to the next level. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas.  
 

Rubrikのセールス組織は、企業や政府機関がサイバー攻撃、悪意ある内部関係者、事業中断に対するレジリエンスを実現できるよう支援する、部門横断型のエリートセールス・プロフェッショナルの集団です。世界トップレベルのセールス・イネーブルメント・プログラムを通じて、継続的な成長の機会を提供します。「One Rubrik」セリングアプローチにより、目標達成、収入の最大化、そしてキャリアの飛躍に必要なあらゆるリソースをご活用いただけます。そしてそれは、世界のデータを守るという、真に意義のある仕事を通じて実現できます。

エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブとして、あなたは日本の大企業市場における新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得を担います。テリトリーを自らの裁量で切り拓くことができ、グローバルチームと世界トップレベルのイネーブルメント・プログラムがあなたのキャリアの飛躍を支えます。私たちが求めているのは、新たな商機の発掘と育成、パイプライン管理、アカウント戦略の実行を通じて新規顧客の獲得に徹底的にこだわり、同時に既存顧客の拡大も推進できる、粘り強く自律的な方です。AEは、セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのチャネルパートナーと連携しながら、日々パイプライン創出に取り組み、セールスクォータの達成を目指します。

 

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute a territory plan for Japan’s large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close
  • Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win
  • Present Rubrik’s cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most
  • Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory
  • Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan
  • Collaborate with and learn from a high-performing One Rubrik sales team that invests in your continued growth

主な業務内容

  • 日本の大企業アカウントを対象としたテリトリープランを策定・実行し、最初の商談からクローズまで、ブッキングの成長に責任を持つ
  • 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する
  • 複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な営業サイクルをリードし、規律ある案件評価(クオリフィケーション)の手法を用いて、正確な予測と受注を実現する
  • 複雑なデータセンターおよびクラウド環境において、Rubrikのサイバーレジリエンス・ソリューションを提案し、いざという時にどれだけ迅速に復旧できるかをお客様に示す
  • セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのパートナーと連携し、共同で販売を進めながらテリトリーを拡大する
  • 現地市場に関する知見をRubrikのリーダーシップと共有し、日本での成長戦略の策定に貢献する
  • 継続的な成長を支援する、高いパフォーマンスを誇る「One Rubrik」セールスチームと協働し、互いに学び合う

 

Experience You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of enterprise Account Executive experience selling Security, Infrastructure, Data, or SaaS solutions
  • A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up)
  • Strong, consistent achievement as an AE, evidenced by President’s Club, top-performer awards, or sustained quota attainment
  • Proven ability to self-source deals and build pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting, rather than relying on customer or partner referrals
  • A repeatable new logo pipeline generation process you can walk us through, from cold account to qualified opportunity
  • Hands-on experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, or another proven enterprise qualification methodology
  • A stable career with meaningful tenure and measurable impact in each role
  • Experience working with channel partners and selling complex solutions

求めるご経験

  • セキュリティ、インフラ、データ、またはSaaSソリューションを扱うエンタープライズ・アカウントエグゼクティブとしての10年以上の経験
  • 大企業アカウントにおける新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得の実績。大手企業(従業員1,000名以上)での3年以上の勤務経験、およびハイパーグロース環境での経験(大手企業からスタートアップ、スケールアップへというキャリアが望ましい)
  • President’s Club、トップパフォーマー表彰、または継続的なクォータ達成などで裏付けられた、AEとしての安定した高い実績
  • 顧客やパートナーからの紹介に頼らず、自らのアウトバウンド活動によって案件を創出し、ゼロからパイプラインを構築した実証済みの能力
  • 未開拓のアカウントから有望な商談(クオリファイド・オポチュニティ)に至るまでの、再現性のあるニューロゴ・パイプライン創出プロセスを具体的に説明できること
  • MEDDICまたはMEDDPICC、もしくはそれに準ずる実績のあるエンタープライズ向け案件評価手法の実務経験
  • 各職務において意義ある在籍期間と測定可能な成果を残してきた、安定したキャリア
  • チャネルパートナーとの協業経験、および複雑なソリューションの販売経験

 

Above all, you will have the ability to operate in a fast-paced, changing environment, self-starter, and operate in a highly matrixed organization. Demonstrate Rubrik’s RIVET values and be a role model, collaborating effectively and creating a positive environment.

何よりも、変化の激しい環境で成果を出せること、自ら率先して行動できること、そしてマトリックス型の組織で円滑に仕事を進められることが重要です。RubrikのRIVETバリューを体現し、ロールモデルとして、周囲と効果的に協働しながら、前向きな職場環境を築いていただける方を求めています。

#LI-FT1

title: Large Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Large Enterprise Account Executive, Japan

Rubrik’s Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity  through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.
 
As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll own new logo growth across Japan’s large enterprise market, with the autonomy to shape your territory and the backing of a global team and a world-class enablement program to take your career to the next level. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas.  
 

Rubrikのセールス組織は、企業や政府機関がサイバー攻撃、悪意ある内部関係者、事業中断に対するレジリエンスを実現できるよう支援する、部門横断型のエリートセールス・プロフェッショナルの集団です。世界トップレベルのセールス・イネーブルメント・プログラムを通じて、継続的な成長の機会を提供します。「One Rubrik」セリングアプローチにより、目標達成、収入の最大化、そしてキャリアの飛躍に必要なあらゆるリソースをご活用いただけます。そしてそれは、世界のデータを守るという、真に意義のある仕事を通じて実現できます。

エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブとして、あなたは日本の大企業市場における新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得を担います。テリトリーを自らの裁量で切り拓くことができ、グローバルチームと世界トップレベルのイネーブルメント・プログラムがあなたのキャリアの飛躍を支えます。私たちが求めているのは、新たな商機の発掘と育成、パイプライン管理、アカウント戦略の実行を通じて新規顧客の獲得に徹底的にこだわり、同時に既存顧客の拡大も推進できる、粘り強く自律的な方です。AEは、セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのチャネルパートナーと連携しながら、日々パイプライン創出に取り組み、セールスクォータの達成を目指します。

 

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute a territory plan for Japan’s large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close
  • Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win
  • Present Rubrik’s cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most
  • Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory
  • Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan
  • Collaborate with and learn from a high-performing One Rubrik sales team that invests in your continued growth

主な業務内容

  • 日本の大企業アカウントを対象としたテリトリープランを策定・実行し、最初の商談からクローズまで、ブッキングの成長に責任を持つ
  • 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する
  • 複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な営業サイクルをリードし、規律ある案件評価(クオリフィケーション)の手法を用いて、正確な予測と受注を実現する
  • 複雑なデータセンターおよびクラウド環境において、Rubrikのサイバーレジリエンス・ソリューションを提案し、いざという時にどれだけ迅速に復旧できるかをお客様に示す
  • セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのパートナーと連携し、共同で販売を進めながらテリトリーを拡大する
  • 現地市場に関する知見をRubrikのリーダーシップと共有し、日本での成長戦略の策定に貢献する
  • 継続的な成長を支援する、高いパフォーマンスを誇る「One Rubrik」セールスチームと協働し、互いに学び合う

 

Experience You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of enterprise Account Executive experience selling Security, Infrastructure, Data, or SaaS solutions
  • A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up)
  • Strong, consistent achievement as an AE, evidenced by President’s Club, top-performer awards, or sustained quota attainment
  • Proven ability to self-source deals and build pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting, rather than relying on customer or partner referrals
  • A repeatable new logo pipeline generation process you can walk us through, from cold account to qualified opportunity
  • Hands-on experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, or another proven enterprise qualification methodology
  • A stable career with meaningful tenure and measurable impact in each role
  • Experience working with channel partners and selling complex solutions

求めるご経験

  • セキュリティ、インフラ、データ、またはSaaSソリューションを扱うエンタープライズ・アカウントエグゼクティブとしての10年以上の経験
  • 大企業アカウントにおける新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得の実績。大手企業(従業員1,000名以上)での3年以上の勤務経験、およびハイパーグロース環境での経験(大手企業からスタートアップ、スケールアップへというキャリアが望ましい)
  • President’s Club、トップパフォーマー表彰、または継続的なクォータ達成などで裏付けられた、AEとしての安定した高い実績
  • 顧客やパートナーからの紹介に頼らず、自らのアウトバウンド活動によって案件を創出し、ゼロからパイプラインを構築した実証済みの能力
  • 未開拓のアカウントから有望な商談(クオリファイド・オポチュニティ)に至るまでの、再現性のあるニューロゴ・パイプライン創出プロセスを具体的に説明できること
  • MEDDICまたはMEDDPICC、もしくはそれに準ずる実績のあるエンタープライズ向け案件評価手法の実務経験
  • 各職務において意義ある在籍期間と測定可能な成果を残してきた、安定したキャリア
  • チャネルパートナーとの協業経験、および複雑なソリューションの販売経験

title: Product Designer
description:
Product Designer 

Based in the Tel Aviv office, in a hybrid model. 
 

About Rubrik

Join the public powerhouse that is securing the future of AI.

Rubrik has officially entered a new era. Fresh off a headline-making successful IPO and boasting over $1.3 Billion in ARR, we have the market stability of a giant and the hunger of a startup. We’ve already conquered Data Security—now, we are pivoting to our most ambitious mission yet: Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation.

As a Rubrik designer, you will be pioneering the next generation User Experiences for the enterprise! From AI to air-gapped immutable backups to defending against ransomware, our tech stack is the definition of cyber resilience. We are a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader and a winner of the Red Dot & iF Design Awards because we believe security and protection should be powerful and usable. Come build the safety net for the AI generation.

About Team & About Role:

Our design team is strong and mighty, with about 60 amazing individuals from all walks of the industry and life located worldwide. As our company and our products grow rapidly, it is crucial to scale the experience of our product and our design team in the right way and with the right people. Every hire counts!

We are seeking a core hire for Rubrik’s design team. We are looking for a highly-skilled UX Designer for our Israel site that can help us drive towards making Rubrik a benchmark for enterprise design.

Sneak peek at our product: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F9949Q-_onc&t=9s

  • Red Dot design Award
  • iF Design Award
  • Rubrik Design Medium Page

What you'll do:

  • Champion the design process, pushing yourself and the design team to take chances and explore big ideas before narrowing in on feasible, creative solutions with attention to detail
  • Produce deliverables at every stage of the design process, such as storyboards, wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and pixel-perfect visual assets
  • Partner with the team of designers, product managers, and engineers throughout the design process - from creating user flows and wireframes to building user interface mockups and prototypes
  • Give and solicit feedback from other designers in order to continually raise our bar for quality
  • Cultivate relationships with our customers to ensure design truly reflects the needs of the users we are serving (UX)
  • Be part of evolving our design language and the design system that upholds it
  • Work side-by-side with our design system UI engineers to ensure precise implementations
  • Help set the bar for consumer-grade design in the enterprise space.


What you’ll bring to the team:

  • 2+ years of relevant hands-on design experience. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Design (Visual Communication, Interactive, etc.).
  • An outstanding portfolio, showcasing your work with a foundation in interaction and visual design, and idea generation.
  • Team Player: Be willing to roll up your sleeves and work cross-functionally
  • Solid presentation skills & the ability to hold your audience's attention
  • Passion for getting things done the ‘right way’ and in a consistent manner across the product. 
  • You are proactive and not afraid to drive towards finding a better solution
  • Someone who listens to others and values understanding above being right
  • Someone who enjoys solving complex design problems!

title: Product Growth Intern (MBA), Summer 2027
description:
Your Career at Rubrik 

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy, and undoing agentic mistakes. For more information, please visit www.rubrik.com and follow @rubrikInc on X (formerly Twitter) and Rubrik on LinkedIn.

About the Product Team 

The Product Team at Rubrik is responsible for driving Rubrik’s mission of securing the world’s data by creating products that simplify the complexity of managing cyber resilience across all applications and types of data. We seek to build consumer-grade experiences to solve the hardest and most complex enterprise challenges.

What Product Growth, Specifically, Does at Rubrik

Rubrik’s Product Growth team sits within product management and reports into Anneka Gupta, Chief Product Officer of Rubrik. Our team bridges Product Management, Analytics, and GTM Strategy to shape Rubrik’s monetization and business model vision. We are responsible for accelerating Rubrik’s business growth by identifying and unlocking levers across the customer lifecycle. Specifically, our team focuses on:

  • Monetization & Packaging Strategy: Designing pricing models, tiering structures, and add-on packaging for core SaaS and AI products.
  • Product-Led Growth & Adoption: Analyzing product telemetry and usage patterns to reduce friction, drive feature adoption, and accelerate time-to-value for customers.
  • Expansion & GTM Alignment: Identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities, optimizing packaging for new market segments, and aligning product capabilities with sales motions.
  • Business Operations & Margin Optimization: Evaluating product economics, cost structures, and gross margin trade-offs to support sustainable, profitable growth.

About the Role

Reporting to a manager on our Product Growth team, you will help design and execute high-impact business models aligned with customer value.

In this role, you will address top-of-mind strategic questions for executive leadership while having direct input into shaping your summer projects based on your interests and business needs. Past intern and team projects have included a combination of designing new product monetization strategies, mapping margin recovery paths, and developing internal AI tools to improve Rubrik’s GTM motions.

Responsibilities include: 

  • Lead the execution and implementation of pricing, packaging, and overall monetization decisions across core platform products and new product initiatives.
  • Partner cross-functionally across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to execute and operationalize new business strategies.
  • Synthesize complex data and market insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Be a "player-coach," guiding team members to improve capabilities and ensuring a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

About You (Your Impact)

You possess a strong blend of strategic thinking, technical curiosity, and financial acumen. You approach challenges with an analytical mindset, using data to bring clarity to ambiguous business problems. You are results-driven, ready to take full ownership of initiatives, and excel at both independent problem solving and cross-functional collaboration.

You bring a high sense of ownership and a true bias for action. Equally important, you operate with humility. You know when to dive deep on your own, when to raise your hand for help, and how to leverage team expertise to deliver the best solution.

Qualifications:

  • Education: MBA from a top program strongly preferred.

description:
About Rubrik's Sales Organization

Rubrik's sales team helps enterprises and government entities achieve cyber resilience — protection against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. Our One Rubrik selling approach means you'll have cross-functional support, dedicated enablement resources, and a clear path to exceed your goals and grow your career. All while doing something that matters: protecting the world's data.

About This Role

Sales Development Representatives are the engine of Rubrik's go-to-market strategy. Through targeted outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification, you'll generate a high-quality pipeline for our field sales teams. This means researching accounts, crafting personalized outreach, and earning meetings with decision-makers at organizations that need what Rubrik offers.

This is a launchpad role — built to develop you into a full-cycle sales professional. Our SDRs receive structured coaching, ongoing training, and a defined career path into closing roles.

What You'll Do

Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Research target accounts, identify high-potential contacts, and craft personalized outreach across email, phone, and social channels to generate qualified meetings for field sales teams
  • Leverage customer success stories, case studies, and proof points in your outreach to demonstrate real-world impact — connecting a prospect's pain to how Rubrik has already solved it for organizations like theirs
  • Follow up on marketing-generated inbound leads within established SLA and compliance metrics
  • Manage your pipeline, leads, and activity data in Salesforce with discipline and accuracy
  • Track and report on your performance against defined activity and outcome targets

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner with your aligned field sales team to develop account strategies and break into priority accounts
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, the competitive landscape, and industry developments to sharpen your messaging and relevance
  • Develop deep fluency in Rubrik's products and the business problems we solve for customers
  • Participate in ongoing coaching sessions, call reviews, pitch competitions, and bootcamps designed to accelerate your sales skills.

What You'll Bring

Required:

  • 0–2 years of experience in B2B sales, lead generation, or a customer-facing role (internships and non-traditional backgrounds welcome)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Interest and aptitude for learning technical concepts quickly
  • Comfort working in a metrics-driven environment with clear daily and weekly targets
  • A genuine desire to build a career in sales and business development
  • Ability to work out of Rubrik's Austin office a minimum of 4 days a week
  • Work-authorization: U.S. citizenship and residency on U.S. soil required

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Orum, or similar sales engagement tools
  • Exposure to cybersecurity or data management technology
  • Experience using AI-powered sales tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gong, Clari, 6sense) to improve prospecting efficiency

What Makes Someone Successful Here

  • Intellectually Hungry — You ask questions, seek feedback, and treat every conversation as a chance to learn something new
  • Integrity — You're honest with prospects, teammates, and yourself. You do the right thing even when no one is watching
  • Execution-Focused — You prioritize ruthlessly, manage your time well, and consistently deliver against your activity and outcome targets
  • Collaborative — You celebrate team wins, share what's working, and actively contribute to a culture that makes everyone better
  • Driven — You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would set for you
  • AI-Tool Fluent — You actively integrate AI and automation into your daily workflow — whether that's using AI-assisted research to build smarter account plans, leveraging tools like conversational intelligence platforms to sharpen call performance, or using generative AI to draft and iterate on personalized outreach at speed. You see AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut

description:

Rubrik, Inc. has an amazing product, a supercharged team and the financial backing of Lightspeed Ventures, Greylock Partners and Khosla Ventures.  Bottom line, if you have limitless drive and like to win, we want to talk to you!

Rubrik is looking for Sales Engineers in the Netherlands to provide technical direction and business guidance to the regional sales team. As a Sales Engineer, you will be accountable for regional revenue goals by driving innovative technical programs and overseeing day-to-day account-level activities. You will be responsible for evangelising, positioning, and architecting the industry's first hyper-converged hybrid cloud data management platform for a mix of enterprise, mid-market, and small business customers throughout your region.

About the position:

  • Provides technical leadership and direction to customers and internal staff in the development of fully integrated technology solutions in support of pre-sales activities in the assigned market.
  • Assists in the analysis, design and development of fully integrated technology solutions.
  • Demonstrates technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Rubrik’s products, distributed architectures, file systems, and competitive storage offerings in the SAN product space.
  • Acts as technical expert and consultant to develop and propose solutions that meet the technology and business requirements of assigned customers.

title: Security Engineer - Identity and Access
description:
About the team 

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.3

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and technically deep Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to execute technical strategy across our entire Identity and Access Security management program. This domain spans a broad and increasingly complex set of disciplines, including Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Access Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Non-Human Identity (NHI) security, and the emerging space of Agentic Identity security. 

This is fundamentally a hands-on role. You will be expected to personally design systems from the ground up and build automation that scales across a large and diverse application portfolio. At the same time, this role carries significant cross-functional weight: you will be partnering closely and continuously with Information Security, IT, Engineering and the many application-owning teams distributed across the company, driving the identity security initiatives in alignment with the overall business objectives.

What you'll do

  • Solution Design
    Design and build IAM solutions — including configurations, integrations, and workflows — that align with evolving business requirements, security policies and regulatory requirements (eg., SOX, GDPR).
  • Application Onboarding & Integration
    Lead the onboarding of applications into IAM platforms, integrating across diverse systems including major cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and in-house systems.
  • Build automation and policy-as-code frameworks
    Manage identity access policies as versioned, auditable code — using source control, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code to automate identity and access management changes instead of manual, ticket-driven processes.
  • Deepen identity governance platform integrations
    Build and extend automated provisioning/deprovisioning, entitlement aggregation, and access certification workflows across the application portfolio.
  • Privileged Access Management
    Design privileged access models across applications and endpoints — including session management and just-in-time elevation — to minimize standing access without slowing teams down.
  • Non-human/Agentic identity governance
    Build inventory, risk-scoring, runtime policy enforcement and remediation tooling for service accounts, API keys, workload identities, AI agents etc 
  • IAM Platform Auditing & Posture Management
    Review and audit identity and access management platforms to identify security misconfigurations, strengthen security policies, and enforce industry best practices.
  • Incident Response & Forensics Support
    Provide subject matter expertise during security incidents to support investigations into identity and access related events.
  • On-Call Coverage & Escalations
    Engage in on-call rotations and provide technical escalation support outside standard business hours. 
  • Technical governance and design reviews
    Enforce technical standards across the team, evaluate identity related design proposals, and serve as the main escalation point for complex identity security decisions and integration challenges

Experience you'll need

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with deep hands-on experience implementing and managing IAM solutions within leading cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Proficiency with modern identity platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, or equivalents) and identity protocols such as SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth.
  • Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles, Non-Human Identities/AI Identities and Access Certification processes.
  • Proficiency in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go), with experience in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., Terraform, GitHub Actions) preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience designing least-privilege / RBAC or ABAC models at scale, and reasoning about tradeoffs between security posture and developer/user friction.
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment (e.g., SOX) and translating control requirements into engineering work.
  • Track record of technical leadership: driving cross-team design decisions, writing technical documentation.

Additional skills

  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaborations and drive technical security initiatives.
  • Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and lead in fast-paced and dynamic technical environments.

  • Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory

主な業務内容

  • 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する
  • 複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な営業サイクルをリードし、規律ある案件評価(クオリフィケーション)の手法を用いて、正確な予測と受注を実現する

title: Software Engineer, Atlas Distributed Systems
description:
About Team

Rubrik Atlas is the core data path for all Rubrik products, whether in the data center, at the edge, or in the cloud. It is a distributed, scale-out, fault tolerant, performant, deduplicated user-space filesystem that uniquely combines block device (ext4/NFS/SMB) and S3 backend storage interfaces. It has been the cornerstone of Rubrik’s innovative tech stack since Day 1.

Since inception this team has attracted some of our strongest technical talent with a very high bar for quality and velocity. We are looking for motivated engineers, who can complement this rockstar team!

 

About Role

Rubrik is expanding at a rapid pace in all directions, from supporting various applications (like Kubernetes, Oracle, EC2, and RDS protection) to hardware storage platforms (like SSD, HDD, S3, Azure Blob, and EBS), to revolutionizing cloud protection (such as SaaS protection, data security, and immutability). At the heart of this transformation is our Atlas platform. We are looking for an experienced distributed systems engineer to guide us through the next stage of the evolution of our data platform.

As an engineer in the team, you’ll design, develop and deliver cutting-edge solutions for the tectonic shifts mentioned above. You will be responsible for outlining the architectural principles we should build towards, prototyping changes, and working with the team to realize the vision in a production-quality system. Your technical direction will also impact multiple teams across Rubrik, as we will need to guide them on how to best build on top of Atlas.

There will be a wide range of features to work on, including cloud storage-backed file systems with effective cost analysis, building data formats optimized for read and write performance for all workloads, deduplication and compression, reliability, resiliency, infinite scalability, performance tooling using eBPF, asynchronous programming, various read-ahead techniques, snapshotting, data integrity, data security, data immutability in the cloud, and many more.

This opportunity provides a potent mix of dynamism, fast startup-like culture, serious technical challenges, and influence across many teams and leaders. If all this sounds interesting, or if you want to know more, please reach out.

 

What are we looking for? 

  • Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 3+ years of experience in Distributed File System
  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development
  • Experience in building systems at scale and backend development
  • Hands on with the code and have hands-on coding skills in C++

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with storage solutions or data protection is a huge plus
  • Experience with nuances public cloud features and costs (like compute, storage, networking, data services) on public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Software Engineer - IAM
description:
Location : Pune
About Team & About Role:

 

As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

 

 
Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.
  • Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.
  • Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.
  • Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.
  • Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.
  • Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.
  • Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.
  • Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).
  • Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.
  • Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

Requirements

Must-have
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory.
  • Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS.
  • Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.
  • Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
  • Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
  • Simple, effective written and verbal communication.
Nice-to-have
  • Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
  • HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).
  • Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).
  • Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.
  • Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).

title: Software Engineer - Product Platform Security
description:
About the Team & Role

The Platform Security Engineering team builds the security features and frameworks that every Rubrik product runs on protecting hundreds of petabytes of data across thousands of enterprise customers globally, from encryption and certificate management to access control and platform hardening at scale. We're a small team with massive impact: the problem space covers the entire Rubrik portfolio, from performant core backend architecture to the AI-powered engineering workflows we and the rest of Rubrik now build with daily.

This is a strong opportunity for new grads and early-career engineers who want real ownership on security-critical systems. You'll help solve problems like:

  • How do we roll out post-quantum cryptography across the backup data path before it's an industry requirement?
  • How do we let customers manage sessions and access against compromise, at enterprise scale?
  • How do we build an access control engine that holds up against dynamic, customer-defined policies unique to a data management platform?
  • How do we secure the AI agents and agentic developer workflows that are now embedded in how Rubrik engineers ship code?

You'll work alongside experienced engineers and deeply technical managers who will mentor you as you grow, on a roadmap with genuine business impact.

 

What You'll Do

Security feature development

  • Design and steer AI to write clean, well-tested code in Go, Scala, or Python for scalable, secure platform services.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions.
  • Identify attack surfaces and build solutions to harden Rubrik products.
  • Triage, debug, and drive product/system issues to resolution with clear ownership.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as a core part of your daily engineering, while learning to treat AI-generated code as untrusted input that gets the same security scrutiny as any other contribution.

Security code and design reviews

  • Review code and design docs from other teams to flag security concerns before they ship.
  • Help extend our review practices to cover AI-powered features and AI agents as they become part of Rubrik's product surface.
  • Contribute to secure coding guidelines and evangelize them across engineering.

Team collaboration

  • Partner with Product Management, UI/UX, docs, InfoSec, and support to turn security requirements into shipped features.
  • Participate in planning, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.

 

How We Build and Secure with AI

AI isn't a side note for this team, it's part of the job on both sides:

  • As builders: you'll use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your normal workflow, the same way the rest of Rubrik engineering does.
  • As security engineers: you'll help define what "secure" means for AI-generated code, AI-powered features, and autonomous agents acting inside Rubrik's infrastructure, an active, fast-moving part of our roadmap.

 

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 0-2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, and bootcamps count).
  • Strong fundamentals in at least one language (Go, Java, Python,  C++, or similar) and in data structures, algorithms, and testing.
  • Genuine interest in security, curious about how systems break and motivated to build things that don't.
  • A proactive, self-directed learning style; comfortable asking questions and diving into ambiguity.

 

Preferred

  • Coursework, personal projects, or internships in cybersecurity, cryptography, or systems security.
  • Comfort with Linux/Unix, Git, and basic networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar).
  • Interest in open-source security tooling or the broader security community.

What Makes a Great Candidate

Beyond the qualifications above, the traits that predict success on this team:

  • Thinks critically - can analyze problems and reason through potential security implications, not just implement what's asked.
  • Collaborates well - enjoys working with others and learning from teammates across disciplines.
  • Pays attention to detail - understands that small details matter in security.

 

Growth & Mentorship

You'll be paired with senior engineers who invest directly in your growth. Over time, expect to build real depth in:

  • Applied cryptography, secure protocol design, and threat modeling.
  • Distributed systems, API design, and system-level security testing.
  • Security code review — spotting vulnerability patterns in both human- and AI-written code.
  • Technical communication, documentation, and (as you grow) mentoring others yourself.

 

We back this with a dedicated mentorship program, regular tech talks and learning sessions, and support for security conferences and training.

Why Join Shield Platform?

The best entry point into security engineering we know of: direct ownership on mission-critical production systems that safeguard Fortune 500 enterprises and critical infrastructure worldwide, mentorship from veteran security architects, and a forward-looking roadmap spanning post-quantum cryptography to AI agent security that puts you at the absolute forefront of enterprise security engineering.

•    Willingness to undergo a Single Source Background Investigation if required.

Security and Privacy Responsibilities section: 

This position carries special Security and Privacy Responsibilities for protecting the U.S. Federal Government’s interests:

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an Associate Counsel to join Commvault’s Trust Team. Reporting within Legal, you will serve as the primary legal partner to the Procurement team, focusing on the review, negotiation, and closing of vendor contracts. This position is well suited for a resourceful, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and seeks to build expertise across multiple legal disciplines. You will work with Procurement and business stakeholders to move purchases forward while addressing the privacy, security, commercial, and operational risks that matter most to Commvault.

The ideal candidate is a practical negotiator who can manage a varied contract pipeline, make sound risk-based decisions, and build strong relationships across the business. You will partner closely with colleagues in Security, Privacy, Finance, and other teams to resolve issues efficiently and improve how Commvault contracts with its vendors.

What you’ll do…

·       Act as a trusted advisor to the business.

·       Serve as Legal’s primary partner to Procurement on vendor contracting, providing timely advice on issues that require legal judgment.

·       Review and negotiate vendor agreements and provisions referred to Legal under agreed escalation criteria, with direct involvement in complex or higher-risk matters.

·       Assist with the development and maintenance of vendor contracting playbooks, templates, fallback positions, and escalation guidance that enable efficient handling of routine issues.

·       Identify recurring issues and improve guidance, training, and processes to reduce unnecessary escalations

·       Inform procurement strategy and manage other procurement related processes.

·       Partner with Security, Privacy, and relevant business stakeholders to resolve escalated vendor contract issues, particularly those involving data protection, security, and operational commitment.

Who you are?

·       Law degree and professional qualifications appropriate to the hiring location.

·       At least two years of legal experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, including experience with technology vendor contracts.

·       Experience assessing escalated contract issues, negotiating departures from standard positions, and advising business stakeholders on practical resolutions.

·       Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and recognize when an issue requires further escalation.

·       Working knowledge of the technology sector, particularly SaaS, cloud services, and related vendor agreements.

·       Strong business judgment and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The Opportunity

Commvault is seeking an Emerging Cloud Native Account Executive to drive new business and expand our footprint in the SaaS market. This role targets accounts that are heavily invested in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, particularly organizations that are native to the cloud environment. The ideal candidate is a tenured professional with a strong hunter mentality, capable of managing the full sales cycle from prospecting through to purchase order closure.

This role is ideal for a driven, results-oriented sales professional who excels in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, and who is passionate about leveraging cloud technologies to solve business challenges. If you are ready to take on the challenge of expanding Commvault’s presence in the cloud-native market, apply today.

What you’ll do…

  • Target and penetrate whitespace accounts in the cloud-native ecosystem, identifying opportunities for new account growth among heavy spenders on AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans to acquire new clients, leveraging in-depth knowledge of the cloud services market and competitor landscape.
  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial contact and discovery through contract negotiation and closing, maintaining responsibility for achieving sales quotas.
  • Conduct in-depth research to understand the specific needs of each prospect, tailoring presentations and proposals to align closely with their business objectives and cloud strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers within target accounts, establishing Commvault as a trusted partner in cloud data management solutions.
  • Collaborate with technical and marketing teams to ensure that presentations and demos effectively communicate the value proposition of our solutions in the context of cloud-native operations.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of all sales and customer interactions within CRM systems.
  • Travel to customer sites, partner events, and tradeshows to engage with prospects and enhance market presence.
  • Achieve and exceed sales targets, maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities for account growth.

Who you are…

  • Preferred 1-2 years of relevant experience in software or SaaS sales, ideally with a strong track record of cold calling and closing high-value deals.
  • Proven track record of successful sales experience in the cloud technology space, particularly with SaaS products and cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Strong hunter mindset with the ability to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities in a competitive environment.
  • Exceptional negotiation and closing skills, with a history of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a cloud-native sales environment.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying complex technical information to a variety of audiences.
  • Proficiency in using CRM software and sales enablement tools to manage sales processes and customer engagements effectively.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to operate independently and as part of a broader sales team.
  • Willingness to travel to meet with prospects, attend industry events, and maintain a high level of market visibility.

Meet the Hiring Manager:

Tim Coffey - Manager, Emerging Cloud Native Sales

You’ll love working here because:

  • High income earning opportunities based on self-performance
  • Opportunity for Presidents Club
  • Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Generous competitive benefits supporting your health, financial security, and work-life balance

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects. The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate/expand his/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers’ environment, current challenges/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition. The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.

Position Responsibilities

  • Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established – large, complex prospects and customer.
  • Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.
  • Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer/prospect leadership.
  • Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.
  • Manage a matrixed sales team; liaison with clients, Deal Desk, inside sales, partners, channels, sales engineers, professional services, finance and legal to drive a prospect to close
  • Establish and maintain a productive, professional relationship with key personnel in assigned customer/prospect accounts.
  • Construct and deliver tangible business cases at the CXO level including financial (ROI & TCO), technical and strategic value propositions
  • Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to new and existing clients
  • Identify and build strategic relationships with partners and alliances that have existing relationships with the assigned target accounts
  • Negotiate and close deals following the company’s practices and processes
  • Ensure orders meet all legal and financial requirements
  • Maintain a high level of relevant industry, Commvault and competitive knowledge
  • Plan, attend and coordinate executive briefings
  • Leverage internal sales tools and processes to drive opportunities to a successful close.

Position Requirements

  • Proven experience selling cyber resilience and/or cybersecurity solutions at enterprise level is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Demonstrable success in enterprise software sales, including closing six- and seven-figure deals and leading integrated, cross-functional sales teams.
  • Strong experience navigating complex enterprise sales cycles and engaging senior and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to identify new opportunities, build strategic customer relationships and sell both directly and through partners.
  • Strong communication, influencing, negotiation and listening skills.
  • Background in IT infrastructure, with SaaS experience preferred.
  • Experience within storage, data management, data protection or related technologies would be an added advantage.

Drive quarterly and annual revenue by securing new wins and expanding existing strategic accounts, directly and with partners and alliances.
