Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

 

About the Role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll join the global Platform SRE team responsible for building, operating, and scaling Kong’s multi-region SaaS platform that powers the world’s API connectivity.

You’ll design, automate, and run production systems serving thousands of customers across AWS, GCP, and Azure. You’ll work on everything from multi-region Kubernetes clusters to service mesh and gateway architectures, ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Kong’s SaaS offerings.

This is a hands-on role ideal for engineers who thrive on running production SaaS systems at scale, automating operations, and continuously improving performance, resilience, and deployment pipelines.

 

What You’ll Do:

 - Operate and scale Kong’s global SaaS platform (Konnect), ensuring reliability, availability, and performance across regions and clouds.

 - Build, automate, and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure and deployment workflows using Terraform/Terragrunt, Helm, and ArgoCD.

 - Design, maintain, and optimize multi-region data and caching layers — including PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, and Druid — for high availability and low latency.

 - Operate and improve Kong Gateway and Kong Mesh environments supporting hybrid and distributed architectures.

 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows to automate service delivery and ensure consistent infrastructure changes.

 - Enhance observability and incident response readiness through systems like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and Thanos, defining and tracking SLOs.

 - Collaborate closely with development and security teams to ensure smooth operation of SaaS services in compliance with reliability, security, and regulatory standards.

 - Participate in a global 24/7 on-call rotation and drive continuous improvement of operational playbooks and postmortem practices.

 - Lead and contribute to scaling initiatives that improve elasticity, reliability, and cost-efficiency across the SaaS platform.
   
    

What You’ll Bring:

 - BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

 - Proven experience managing SaaS or PaaS systems at enterprise scale (multi-region, multi-tenant, secure environments).

 - Deep expertise in Kubernetes, including debugging cluster/networking issues and designing for fault tolerance and scalability.

 - Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Terragrunt.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Atlantis, Helm).

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Go, Python, Bash) for automation and tooling.

 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, networking (DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP), load balancers and distributed systems.

 - Experiencing working with API gateway and service mesh technologies

 - Familiarity with streaming systems like Kafka and observability platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana).

 - Experience working in a 24/7/365 production support environment.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Hands-on experience with Kong Gateway, Kong Mesh, or similar service connectivity technologies.

 - Experience operating ClickHouse, Druid, or other time-series and analytics databases.

 - Experience managing PostgreSQL and Redis in multi-region configurations.

 - Working knowledge of AWS networking (PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, Firewalls), Azure VNet, or GCP NCC.

 - Strong understanding of disaster recovery, resiliency testing, and compliance-driven reliability practices.

title: Software Engineer 2, Managed Gateways
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

 - Dedicated cloud gateways https://konghq.com/blog/product-releases/dedicated-cloud-gateways provide organizations with a fully managed, private, and isolated gateway environment that eliminates the complexity of managing infrastructure while ensuring security and compliance. Designed for high performance and scalability, these gateways allow businesses to control traffic flow across their services without sharing resources with other customers.

 - Serverless gateways https://konghq.com/blog/product-releases/serverless-gateways offer a fully managed, elastic API gateway solution that meets traffic demands without the need for provisioning or managing any underlying infrastructure. Built to simplify operations and reduce costs, these gateways empower organizations to deploy APIs seamlessly in serverless environments, ensuring efficient resource utilization.

This is a unique opportunity to join early in the product evolution of a key Kong growth bet that is already clocking double-digit YoY adoption. You’ll work on distributed systems, multi-cloud networking, and API infrastructure that form the backbone of modern digital businesses.

 

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll not only build critical components of the Managed Gateways platform, but also take ownership of major features end-to-end, lead technical execution within the team, and mentor peers. You’ll collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineers to shape the technical direction and ensure the platform delivers 99.99% uptime, performance, and developer delight.

 

What You'll Do:

 - Design, develop, and operate highly available distributed systems for Managed Gateways, ensuring resilience to regional and zonal outages.

 - Own and lead delivery of key features/modules, driving them from design through implementation and production rollout.

 - Build microservices and control-plane components that power Kong’s Dedicated Cloud Gateways and Serverless Gateways.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering teams to deliver new features at scale that directly impact customers’ ability to build, secure, and manage APIs.

 - Participate in on-call rotations, owning services in production and driving reliability improvements.

 - Write automated tests, observability hooks, and tooling to ensure reliability and reduce toil.

 - Assist in the hiring process and help grow and mentor engineers on the team.

 - Contribute to shaping the technical roadmap for Managed Gateways, bringing in ideas from infrastructure, networking, and platform engineering.

 - Work in a high-velocity, pre-IPO environment, balancing innovation with reliability and customer impact.

 

What You'll Bring:

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

 - 5+ years of experience building high-performance software, ideally in infrastructure or platform engineering.

 - Strong experience with Golang

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, networking (L4/L7, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP), and cloud-native architectures.

 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

 - Experience building APIs, standardizing APIs in large organizations, and creating API workflows.

 - Experience designing and operating systems to deliver 99.99%+ uptime SLAs.

 - Proven ability to debug complex systems from bit-and-bytes level (packets, protocols) to high-level design.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



This hybrid role is based in Singapore. Fluency in Bahasa (Indonesia) - written and spoken - is expected, as Indonesia will be the primary market served.

 

About The Role:

 

At Kong, our Sales Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around Kong. Sales Development reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. We view our Sales Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at Kong.

 

To aid in this endeavor, we invest heavily in the training and development of our team. This includes a 2-week long sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, and global virtual group training. By joining our team, you are making an investment in yourself that will accelerate the rest of your sales career.

 

Our SDRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across Kong to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

 

Being an SDR is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At Kong, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our SDRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers.

 

The SDR leadership team has a true understanding of where each SDR is at in their personal development process, and mentors and enables them to ensure that they have the means and opportunity to be considered for their next role. At Kong, we truly believe that if you want to earn your MBA in sales, this is the place to be. As a leadership team, we spend an exorbitant amount of time working in the trenches with our teams to help them fine hone their business and sales acumen and ramp them to productivity, success, and greater roles.

 

What You'll Do: 

Your First 90 Days

 - By the end of month 1, you will:

 - Have met your new team and had fun playing with some new tools

 - Become a part of the wider Kong family

 - Have had a successful sales boot camp training

 - Have a good understanding of what makes Kong’s product offerings so special

 - Understand how our Sales Development, Marketing and Account Executive teams all work together

 

By the end of month 2, you will:

 - Be comfortable talking to clients on the phone about Kong

 - Have worked with our Account Executive team on your first opportunity

 - Have shadowed a ton of calls and practiced several role-plays

 - Started delivering your ramp quota

 - By the end of month 3, you will:

 - Know our sales funnel inside and out, and feel confident to add value to our sales org

 - Show clear delivery of our sales methodologies

 - Provide insights to both our Sales Development and marketing organizations to help us continue to iterate and improve

 - Delivered against your ramp quota

 - Role Overview & Key Responsibilities:

 - Work with the Sales team to develop inbound and outbound campaigns from idea generation through to qualified call

 - Develop strong sales and product knowledge.

 - Interact with IT and business decision-makers via telephone, video, LinkedIn, and email

 - Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

 - Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

 - Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

 - Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

 - Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business.

 - Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

 - And any additional tasks required by the manager.
    

What You'll Bring:

 - 1 year or more of strong sales or customer-facing experience.

 - A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals.

 - A ‘hunter’ mentality - comfortable prospecting, cold-calling, and following up on incoming leads and a strong desire to win.

 - Ability and willingness to learn, react to and share lessons learned across the organisation.

 - Open to feedback and can apply to your daily workflow.

 - Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening.

 - An extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, a high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals.

 - Validated time leadership skills and ability to work independently and through coaching.

 - Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment.

 - Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly.

#LI-SP1



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

title: Administrative Assistant-EMEA & APJ
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

About the Role:

The Administrative Assistant provides high-quality administrative and operational support to the EMEA & APJ Sales VPship team. The role is responsible for keeping senior leaders organized, on schedule, and focused on their highest priorities.

This is an execution-focused role centered on calendar management, travel coordination, expense administration, and day-to-day logistics. The position reports to the Executive Assistant to the CRO and is not responsible for business strategy, content ownership, or analysis.



What You'll Do:


CALENDAR & SCHEDULE MANAGEMENT

 - Own and manage complex, multi-time-zone calendars for EMEA & APJ Sales VPs.

 - Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts with minimal disruption.

 - Prioritize meeting requests based on leadership priorities, business rhythms, and urgency.

 - Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to schedule meetings efficiently.

 - Ensure leaders are well prepared and their schedules remain organized and optimized.


TRAVEL COORDINATION

 - Coordinate end-to-end domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and visas.

 - Develop clear, detailed travel itineraries and travel briefs to minimize friction for leaders.

 - Monitor travel plans and proactively manage changes, delays, and disruptions.

 - Ensure all travel arrangements comply with company policies and processes.


EXPENSE MANAGEMENT

 - Prepare, submit, and track expense reports on behalf of supported leaders.

 - Ensure expenses are submitted accurately, promptly, and in accordance with company policies.

 - Manage expense-related follow-ups, questions, and reconciliations as needed.


GENERAL ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT

 - Serve as the primary administrative point of contact and liaison for the EMEA & APJ Sales VPs.

 - Manage incoming and outgoing communications, document distribution, and administrative inquiries with professionalism and discretion.

 - Maintain well-organized digital files and ensure accurate record-keeping of key documents and administrative assets.

 - Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and proactively recommend practical solutions.

 - Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and sound judgment.

Scope of the Role:

The role is designed to enable senior leaders to focus on business priorities by taking ownership of operational and administrative responsibilities.

The following areas are out of scope for this position:

 - QBR and Town Hall content, strategy, narratives, or metrics ownership.

 - Business analysis, sales reporting, or data interpretation.

 - People management or HR responsibilities.

 - Budget ownership or financial decision-making.

What You'll Bring:

Required

 - 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or in a similar role supporting senior business leaders.

 - Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-time-zone calendars with a high degree of accuracy and prioritization.

 - Experience coordinating domestic and international travel and preparing detailed travel itineraries.

 - Proficiency with expense management tools and processes.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with professional fluency.

 - Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.

 - High level of discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive or confidential information.

 - Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, and Concur or similar expense platforms.

Preferred:

 - Experience supporting senior leaders within a global or matrixed organization.

 - Experience working with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.

 - Familiarity with EMEA business practices and European and Asia-Pacific working environments.

 - Proficiency in one or more additional European or Asia-Pacific languages.
   
   

About the Team:

This role is part of a growing Executive and Administrative Assistant function designed to provide scalable, high-quality support to the company's Vice Presidents.

As the first EMEA & APJ-focused Administrative Assistant, you will have an opportunity to help establish best practices, shape administrative processes, and define what exceptional administrative support looks like as the team grows.

This is an opportunity for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented professional to make a meaningful impact by enabling senior leaders to operate efficiently across regions and time zones.

description:

About the Role:

Volcano (volcano.dev http://volcano.dev) is a cloud for apps built with coding agents. You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. Most platforms were designed around a person in a console and added agent support later. We started from the agent.

We're a small team and launched publicly in September 2026. Volcano is incubated by Kong and runs as its own company with its own brand.

This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.



What You'll Do:

 - Own the Volcano Cookbook: recipes that build real apps on Volcano with tools developers already use, written up with the code, the decisions and the gotchas.

 - Build templates and examples people can deploy in one step.

Impact

- Run signal-based prospecting across a defined set of intent categories competitive displacement, infrastructure investment, AI/agent initiatives, and more, rather than blanket outbound.

- Qualify and convert inbound interest quickly, applying a modern qualification framework built for fast-moving AI buying cycles (tension, economic impact, buying mandate, proof, and optionality) rather than legacy checklist selling.

- Continuously test messaging, sequencing, and calling approaches, treating your pipeline like an experiment you're always optimizing.

- Build a point of view and public presence in the API/AI infrastructure space, becoming a trusted resource for prospects navigating this shift.

- Feed market and competitive intelligence back to GTM leadership to sharpen targeting and messaging over time.

- Deepen your product fluency by partnering closely with Sales and Product, especially on how enterprises are approaching AI Gateway and token governance.



Your pipeline directly fuels a company at the center of one of the biggest infrastructure shifts in software.



Essential Skills



- 1-2+ years of SDR/ADR experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical or infrastructure product within the Public Sector.

- Genuine AI curiosity - you've used (or are eager to master) modern AI-native prospecting tools, not just traditional sequencers.

- Growth mindset - you treat skill as something built through reps, feedback, and iteration.

- Comfortable on the phone and unafraid of cold outreach; you track and improve your own conversion rate.

- Resilient and self-driven - rejection is data, not a verdict.

- Coachable - you actively seek feedback and adapt quickly to new plays and tooling.



Who Thrives Here



You'll fit right in if you:



- Get energized by fast-moving AI and infrastructure markets.

- Want ownership over your process from signal to sequence to booked meeting.

- Value a culture of experimentation over rigid scripts.

- Care about the quality of every touch, not just the volume.



*Bonus points if you've got exposure to APIs, cloud-native platforms, or AI/agent tooling but curiosity and drive matter more than a specific resume line.



Life at Kong



- Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) program

- Equity -  you help build the category, you share in the upside

- Flexible PTO + company holidays

- Wellness and mental health support

- Learning and development budget

- Hybrid work model with regional hubs

- Regular team events and company offsites

title: Account Development Representative
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



About the Role:

Kong is The AI Connectivity Company. Our platform sits at the centre of how enterprises manage APIs, AI agents, and the infrastructure connecting them and we’re scaling fast. The ADR role is the front line of that growth. The accounts you open today are the expansion stories of tomorrow.

 

As a  Majors / Enterprise Outbound ADR, you’ll identify and qualify new business opportunities across the EMEA Majors / Enterprise segment, working closely with our Sales and Marketing teams. This isn’t just a job, it’s the best way to fast-track a long career in tech sales.

 

We invest heavily in our people: a 4-week sales bootcamp, weekly 1-1 mentorship, continuous training throughout your tenure, and a leadership team that actually gets in the trenches with you. If you want an MBA in sales, this is the place to earn it.

 

Your first 90 days

 - Month 1: Meet your team, complete bootcamp, and fall in love with what Kong actually does.

 - Month 2: Pick up the phone with confidence, master our tech stach (Nooks, Claude, Gemini, Sumble, Lusha etc) and work your first live opportunity, and hit your ramp quota.

 - Month 3: Own your funnel, share what’s working, and what needs optimisation.
   
    

What You’ll Do:

 - Build and run outbound campaigns end-to-end,  from idea to qualified meeting

 - Engage decision-makers across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video

 - Partner closely with AEs and Marketing, you’re a connector, not just a top-of-funnel rep

 - Keep Salesforce clean and your pipeline tighter, process matters here

 - Utilise AI to boost productivity, work at pace and personalise your messaging

 - Invest in your own development,  your manager will meet you where you are and help you get to what’s next

 

What You’ll Bring:

 - Some experience in a customer-facing or sales role — internships, retail, or hospitality count if you can show you know how to build rapport and drive outcomes

 - A hunter mentality, you’re not waiting to be handed leads, you go and find them

 - High coachability, you take feedback well, apply it fast, and ask for more

 - Strong communicator, clear and confident in writing and on a call

 - Genuine curiosity about technology - you don’t need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what Kong does and why it matters
   
    

Why Kong?

 - Be part of the company defining the future of AI connectivity. APIs and agents run on Kong

 - Real career development -  our ADRs are the next wave of AEs in the tech, and our leadership team is invested in making that happen

 - Hybrid from our central London office - walking distance from Bank Station and London Bridge, 2–3 days a week in the office. A beautiful location to work from in Summer

 - Competitive comp, benefits, and a team that shows up with integrity, energy, and purpose

 

Every day, we raise the bar of what great looks like. Ready to help set it?

 - 3+ years of programming in server-side applications and components.

 - Hands on experience with either Golang or Rust 

 - Experience building and debugging applications that are highly scalable, distributed, reliable and resilient.

 - Solid hands-on low-level technical expertise in Linux systems troubleshooting, and profiling.

 - Strong sense of ownership and excellent verbal and written communication skills -- engineers at Kong write the documentation for their products

 - Familiarity with AI LLM concepts and applications development

 - Hands on experience with NGINX/OpenResty/Kong/LuaJIT.

description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



Why Kong?
Every enterprise building microservices, cloud-native architectures, and generative AI workloads runs on APIs. Kong is the cloud-native API and AI connectivity company, trusted by Fortune 500s and millions of developers worldwide.

If you sell infrastructure, dev tools, or data platforms, you know what developer mindshare is worth. At Kong, you aren’t evangelizing unproven tech from scratch. You’re monetizing an existing open-source groundswell and partnering with enterprise architecture, security, and engineering leaders to power mission-critical API traffic.

What makes this role high-leverage

 - A proven land-and-expand engine: Convert open-source and developer adoption into strategic, multi-year enterprise platform commitments (Kong Konnect, AI Gateway, Service Mesh).

 - High-impact deals: Run complex, multi-threaded enterprise cycles (100k–1M+ ACV) across CTO, VP of Platform/Architecture, and CISO personas.

 - Modern AI and cloud relevance: Put Kong at the center of the enterprise stack, securing, managing, and routing LLM traffic alongside traditional microservices.

 - True cross-functional support: Backed by world-class Solutions Engineers, dedicated SDRs, Customer Success, and an active developer community.

 - Full-cycle ownership: Your territory, your pipeline, your deals. You run everything from first outreach through negotiation to close.

 - A voice in the product: What you hear from customers goes straight to product and marketing, and it shapes what we build and how we take it to market.

 - Visibility: Represent Kong at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.
   
   

What you bring

 - Enterprise software track record: 5+ years of full-cycle closing with mid-market and enterprise logos (>1,000 employees), and consistent quota overachievement.

 - Ecosystem literacy: Direct experience in modern B2B SaaS or infrastructure, ideally across commercial open source (COSS), developer platforms, cloud/networking, APIs, Kubernetes, or observability.

 - Multi-persona discovery: You can work bottoms-up with technical champions (engineers, architects) and top-down with executive economic buyers (CTO, VP Eng, CISO).

 - Strategic territory ownership: A disciplined MEDDPICC or Command of the Message approach to pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and deal execution.

 - Consultative selling: You find the customer’s actual problem, tie the solution to a business outcome, and tailor every demo to match.

 - Negotiation under pressure: You’re comfortable in high-stakes conversations and build relationships that last past the signature.

 - Account planning and CRM discipline: You research accounts and industry trends before you call, and you keep Salesforce (or similar) current enough to forecast from.

 - Builder mindset: You thrive in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, take ownership of your territory, and adjust when the market shifts.
   
   

Why top sellers join us

 - Clear category winner: Gartner Leader with top-tier adoption metrics and continuous product momentum.

 - Uncapped upside: Highly competitive base/variable structure, accelerators, and equity.

 - Culture of execution: Autonomous, fast-moving, and low on bureaucracy. Built for builders and closers.
